generic.Defined scope/population: Billing accounts with an approved mid-term payment plan or billing mode change request.
generic.In-scope period: Requests received between the current cycle open date and the next unbilled installment due date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: New payment plan code, change effective date, mode-change fee and revised installment count are set in BillingCenter.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Remaining installments after the change sum to unbilled written premium to the cent.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed change request plus before and after installment schedules are filed with a timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requests that would split an installment mid-period are logged and deferred to the next due date.
generic.Test population: All mid-term billing mode changes applied to billing accounts in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero cent variance to unbilled written premium and zero orphaned installment rows from the old plan.
generic.Exception handling path: A failed schedule rebuild is reversed by the Billing Specialist and rerun before the next notice run.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: New plan is active with a regenerated schedule and the next notice shows the new amount and due date.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter billing account transaction history and the change packet in the document management repository.

steps.title: Open the billing account in Guidewire BillingCenter and record the current payment plan
sop: Search BillingCenter by policy number and open the billing account for the requested change.
Record the current payment plan, next due date and remaining installment count.
Confirm the account has no unapplied cash or open dispute that would distort the rebuild.
Done when the current plan and schedule are captured on the change case.
verify: Re-open the account and compare the captured values to the BillingCenter screen.
Pass when the captured plan and remaining installment count match BillingCenter exactly.

steps.title: Verify the change request and policy status in the policy administration system
sop: Open the policy in the policy administration system and confirm it is in force.
Confirm the requested billing mode is permitted for the product and policy state.
Confirm the written premium used for the rebuild includes all endorsements to date.
Done when policy status and permitted mode are confirmed on the change case.
verify: Compare the policy written premium to the billing account total charges.
Pass when the policy is in force and the requested mode is permitted for that product and state.

steps.title: Set the new payment plan and effective date on the billing account in BillingCenter
sop: Select the plan code matching the requested annual, semi-annual, quarterly or monthly EFT mode.
Set the change effective date on or after the next unbilled installment due date.
Save the change without releasing it so the schedule can be previewed first.
Done when the new plan and effective date are staged on the account.
verify: Check that no already-billed installment falls inside the change effective window.
Pass when the effective date is on or after the next unbilled installment due date.

steps.title: Rebuild and review the installment schedule preview in BillingCenter
sop: Run the installment schedule preview for the new payment plan.
Total the remaining installments and compare to unbilled written premium.
Confirm no installment carries a due date beyond policy expiration.
Done when the preview total equals unbilled written premium to the cent.
verify: List superseded plan installments and confirm none remain open on the account.
Pass when the schedule totals agree to the cent and no orphaned installment rows exist.

steps.title: Add the state-filed mode-change or installment fee in BillingCenter
sop: Look up the mode-change and installment fee for the policy state in the filed fee schedule.
Add the fee as a separate charge type on the billing account, not folded into premium.
Suppress the fee where the state or product prohibits it.
Done when the correct fee is charged or documented as not applicable.
verify: Compare the charged fee amount to the filed fee schedule row for the policy state.
Pass when the fee charged matches the filed schedule or is correctly suppressed.

steps.title: Regenerate the next premium notice and file the change packet in the document repository
sop: Regenerate the next premium notice and confirm it shows the new amount and due date.
Export the before and after installment schedules and the signed change request.
File the packet in the document management repository indexed by policy number.
Done when the regenerated notice and the filed change packet both exist.
verify: Retrieve the packet from the document repository by policy number.
Pass when the notice shows the new amount and due date and the packet is retrievable.

steps.title: Approve and release the billing mode change in BillingCenter
sop: Review the change case, the rebuilt schedule and the fee applied.
Confirm the reconciliation to unbilled written premium was performed by the specialist.
Release the change so it takes effect on the stated effective date.
Done when the change is released and the account shows the new plan as active.
verify: Re-run the account inquiry after release and check the plan and schedule.
Pass when the active plan, effective date and schedule match the approved change case.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every active state and line combination that requires an advance premium notice lead time.
generic.In-scope period: The current statutory review cycle covering all bills mailed in the period under review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each matrix row carries state, line, lead-time days and a current statute or bulletin citation.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Configured lead-time parameter count equals the count of active state and line combinations.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Advance-notice matrix version and the BillingCenter parameter export are retained with an effective date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: States configured at the bare statutory minimum with no buffer are logged and referred to compliance.
generic.Test population: All state and line combinations with in-force policies billed during the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero states with a configured lead time shorter than the statutory minimum.
generic.Exception handling path: A short lead time is corrected in configuration the same day and affected notices are re-mailed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every active state and line has a cited lead-time parameter and sample bills mail at or before the minimum.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter notice configuration export and the advance-notice matrix in the document management repository.

steps.title: Assemble the state and line advance-notice matrix in the document management repository
sop: List every active state and line combination from the policy administration system.
Record the statutory advance-notice days for each row with its statute or bulletin citation.
Version the matrix and file it in the document management repository.
Done when every active state and line row has a citation and a lead-time value.
verify: Sample rows against the cited statute or bulletin text.
Pass when no active state and line row lacks a current citation.

steps.title: Confirm the in-force state and line inventory in the policy administration system
sop: Extract distinct policy state and line combinations for in-force business.
Compare the extract to the matrix rows and flag any combination not covered.
Return the gap list to the billing operations manager.
Done when the matrix covers every in-force state and line combination.
verify: Count matrix rows against distinct in-force combinations.
Pass when the two counts agree with no uncovered combination.

steps.title: Configure the notice lead-time parameter per state and line in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Enter the lead-time parameter for each state and line rather than one company-wide default.
Add the agreed operational buffer on top of the statutory minimum where policy allows.
Save the configuration and export the parameter list for review.
Done when every matrix row has a matching parameter configured in BillingCenter.
verify: Compare the exported parameter list line by line to the matrix.
Pass when every parameter equals or exceeds the matrix statutory minimum.

steps.title: Run a sample bill for the shortest-lead-time state in BillingCenter
sop: Select the state with the shortest statutory lead time from the matrix.
Generate a sample premium notice and read the calculated print and mail date.
Compare the mail date to the due date less the statutory days.
Done when the sample mail date is at or before the statutory deadline.
verify: Repeat the sample for one additional short-lead-time state.
Pass when both samples mail at or before their statutory deadlines.

steps.title: Confirm mailing-date stamping is captured on the notice record in BillingCenter
sop: Open a released notice record and confirm the mail date field is populated from the vendor file.
Confirm the stamped date is retained on the notice history and not overwritten by reprints.
Confirm proof of mailing can be exported for a named policy on demand.
Done when a mail date and exportable proof exist for the sampled notices.
verify: Export proof of mailing for one sampled policy and open the output.
Pass when the export shows the policy, the notice and a stamped mailing date.

steps.title: File the compliance exception list for zero-buffer states in the document repository
sop: List states where the configured lead time equals the statutory minimum with no buffer.
Record the operational risk and the recommended buffer for each.
File the list in the document repository and raise it to compliance.
Done when every zero-buffer state is logged and referred with a recommendation.
verify: Check each zero-buffer state appears on the referral with a disposition.
Pass when no zero-buffer state is missing from the compliance referral.

generic.Defined scope/population: New and re-rated policies awaiting a billing cycle code on their billing account.
generic.In-scope period: Policies bound or changed in the current billing setup cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Billing cycle code, anchor day, first due date and installment count are set on the billing account.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Installment count produced by the cycle equals the count expected for the elected payment plan.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Cycle assignment is recorded in BillingCenter account history with user and timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Policies whose cycle would run past expiration are logged and reassigned to a shorter plan.
generic.Test population: All billing accounts assigned a cycle during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero accounts with a first due date before policy effective date or an installment past expiration.
generic.Exception handling path: An invalid cycle is corrected by the Billing Specialist before the first notice generation run.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Cycle code and anchor day are consistent with the policy effective date and elected payment plan.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter billing account cycle configuration and the generated installment schedule.

steps.title: Read the elected payment plan from the policy record in the policy administration system
sop: Open the bound policy and read the elected payment plan and policy term dates.
Note the policy effective date, expiration date and any producer billing instruction.
Pass the elected plan and dates to the billing specialist.
Done when the elected plan and term dates are recorded on the setup case.
verify: Compare the recorded plan to the policy declarations page.
Pass when the recorded plan and term dates match the policy record.

steps.title: Select the matching billing cycle code on the billing account in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Open the billing account and select the cycle code that maps to the elected payment plan.
Reject any cycle code not offered for the product and policy state.
Save the cycle code on the account.
Done when the cycle code on the account maps to the elected payment plan.
verify: Compare the saved cycle code to the plan-to-cycle mapping table.
Pass when the cycle code is the mapped value for the elected plan.

steps.title: Set the cycle anchor day so the first due date follows the policy effective date
sop: Set the anchor day from the policy effective date or the agreed billing day.
Confirm the calculated first due date falls on or after the policy effective date.
Adjust the anchor day if the first due date lands before coverage starts.
Done when the first due date is on or after the policy effective date.
verify: Read the first due date from the generated schedule.
Pass when the first due date is not earlier than the policy effective date.

steps.title: Generate the installment schedule in BillingCenter and check the installment count
sop: Generate the schedule for the assigned cycle.
Count the installments produced and compare to the expected count for the plan.
Investigate any short or long count before accepting the schedule.
Done when the installment count equals the expected count for the elected plan.
verify: Recount the schedule rows against the plan definition.
Pass when the produced installment count equals the expected count.

steps.title: Confirm no installment falls after policy expiration in the BillingCenter schedule
sop: Sort the schedule by due date and read the final installment date.
Compare the final due date to the policy expiration date.
Reassign the cycle or anchor day if the final installment falls after expiration.
Done when the final installment due date is on or before policy expiration.
verify: Re-read the final installment date after any adjustment.
Pass when no installment carries a due date after policy expiration.

steps.title: Record the cycle assignment on the billing account history in BillingCenter
sop: Save the cycle assignment so the account history records user and timestamp.
Note the elected plan, anchor day and installment count on the setup case.
Release the account for first-bill generation.
Done when the assignment is recorded and the account is released for billing.
verify: Open the account history and read the assignment entry.
Pass when the history entry shows the cycle code, user and timestamp.

generic.Defined scope/population: Policyholders electing EFT or card payment who must supply bank account or card details.
generic.In-scope period: Bank and card captures completed during the current billing setup or mandate refresh cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Payment token, last four digits, account type and account holder name are stored on the billing account.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of stored payment tokens equals the count of active EFT or card elections.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dated debit authorisation and gateway verification response are retained against the billing account.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed routing check-digit or verification attempts are logged with the corrective action taken.
generic.Test population: All bank and card captures completed in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero records holding a full account number or card number in free text or attachments.
generic.Exception handling path: A failed verification blocks mandate activation and is returned to the policyholder for corrected details.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Billing account holds a token with last-four masking and a dated debit authorisation.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter payment instrument record, Payment Gateway verification log and the document repository.

steps.title: Launch the Payment Gateway hosted capture field from the billing account in BillingCenter
sop: Open the billing account and start the payment instrument capture flow.
Confirm the hosted gateway field renders rather than an internal input form.
Never key the account or card number into a BillingCenter note or case field.
Done when the hosted gateway capture field is open for the policyholder to complete.
verify: Check that no account or card number is present in the case or note fields.
Pass when capture occurs only in the hosted gateway field.

steps.title: Capture routing and account number through the Payment Gateway hosted field
sop: Have the policyholder enter routing number, account number and account type.
Submit the capture so the gateway returns a token and last four digits only.
Confirm BillingCenter stores the token and masked value, not the raw number.
Done when the billing account holds a gateway token with last-four masking.
verify: Open the stored payment instrument record in BillingCenter.
Pass when only a token and last four digits are stored on the record.

steps.title: Validate the ABA routing check digit and account type in the Payment Gateway
sop: Run the routing number through the gateway validation service.
Confirm the check digit passes and the institution is a valid ACH participant.
Confirm the account type recorded is checking or savings as stated by the payor.
Done when routing validation passes and account type is confirmed.
verify: Read the gateway validation response code.
Pass when routing validation returns a success response and a valid account type.

steps.title: Run a zero-dollar or one-dollar card verification in the Payment Gateway
sop: For a card instrument, submit a zero-dollar or one-dollar verification authorisation.
Read the authorisation response and reject the instrument on a decline.
Void or let the verification amount reverse so the payor is not charged.
Done when a successful verification authorisation is recorded for the card.
verify: Read the gateway authorisation reference on the instrument record.
Pass when a successful verification reference is present before mandate activation.

steps.title: Match the account holder name to the payor of record in BillingCenter
sop: Compare the account holder name returned by the gateway to the payor of record.
Where the names differ, request the third-party payor authorisation before proceeding.
File the authorisation in the document management repository against the policy.
Done when names match or a filed third-party payor authorisation exists.
verify: Retrieve the third-party authorisation from the document repository where applicable.
Pass when every name mismatch has a filed and retrievable authorisation.

steps.title: Scan the billing case attachments in the document repository for prohibited images
sop: Review every attachment on the billing case and the linked repository folder.
Remove or redact any image or screenshot showing a full account or card number.
Record the removal on the case so the deletion is traceable.
Done when no attachment holds a full account or card number.
verify: Re-list the case attachments and repository index entries.
Pass when no attachment contains an unmasked account or card number.

generic.Defined scope/population: Employer-sponsored and group policies requiring a list-bill or payroll-deduction arrangement.
generic.In-scope period: Group arrangements set up or amended in the current group onboarding cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Group account, remittance cycle, census file layout and payment tolerance are configured in BillingCenter.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Billed lives and total premium on the group account tie to the group master policy schedule.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Loaded census file version and the test list bill sent to the administrator are retained with dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Certificates that fail to link to the group account are logged with the remediation applied.
generic.Test population: All group billing arrangements activated during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero covered certificates left on individual direct bill after group activation.
generic.Exception handling path: Short remittances suspend for research rather than auto-writing off against the group account.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Group account is active with all certificates linked and a remittance cycle matching payroll frequency.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter group billing account, the census workbook in Microsoft Excel and the policy system group master.

steps.title: Create the list-bill or payroll-deduction billing account in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Create the group billing account keyed to the group master policy number.
Record the employer legal name, remittance address and administrator contact.
Set the account type to list bill or payroll deduction as elected.
Done when the group billing account exists with the employer details recorded.
verify: Open the account and compare the employer details to the group master policy.
Pass when the account details match the group master policy record.

steps.title: Link every covered certificate to the group account in BillingCenter
sop: Extract the covered certificate list from the policy administration system.
Link each certificate to the group billing account.
Close or suppress any individual direct-bill account for those certificates.
Done when every covered certificate points at the group billing account.
verify: Compare linked certificate count to the covered certificate extract.
Pass when counts agree and no covered certificate remains on individual direct bill.

steps.title: Set the group remittance cycle to the employer payroll frequency in BillingCenter
sop: Confirm the employer payroll frequency from the group agreement.
Set the remittance cycle to weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly or monthly to match.
Set the bill production date to allow the administrator time before the payroll run.
Done when the remittance cycle matches the stated payroll frequency.
verify: Compare the configured cycle to the payroll frequency in the group agreement.
Pass when the configured cycle equals the employer payroll frequency.

steps.title: Load the initial census in Microsoft Excel and tie it to the group master schedule
sop: Load the employer census workbook and total the billed lives and premium.
Compare both totals to the group master policy schedule.
Investigate and clear any variance before the first bill is produced.
Done when census lives and premium tie to the group master schedule.
verify: Recompute the census totals and compare to the policy system schedule.
Pass when billed lives and total premium agree with no unexplained variance.

steps.title: Configure the underpayment and overpayment tolerance on the group account in BillingCenter
sop: Set the remittance variance tolerance for the group account.
Configure short remittances to suspend for research rather than auto write-off.
Configure overpayments to hold as unapplied credit on the group account.
Done when tolerance and suspend behaviour are configured on the account.
verify: Post a test short remittance against the account in a test cycle.
Pass when the short remittance suspends rather than writing off automatically.

steps.title: Send a test list bill to the group administrator from BillingCenter
sop: Produce a test list bill for the loaded census and review the layout.
Send it to the group administrator and request confirmation the layout is usable.
Confirm the member identifiers align with the employer payroll system keys.
Done when the administrator confirms the test bill layout is usable.
verify: Retain the administrator confirmation against the group account.
Pass when a dated administrator confirmation of the test bill exists.

steps.title: Activate the group arrangement in BillingCenter and confirm individual billing is closed
sop: Activate the group billing account from the agreed effective date.
Re-run the individual direct-bill exception list for the covered certificates.
Close any remaining individual account found on the list.
Done when the group arrangement is active and no individual duplicate remains.
verify: Re-run the covered certificate billing route report after activation.
Pass when every covered certificate bills only through the group account.

generic.Defined scope/population: New business billing accounts awaiting activation confirmation from the policy team.
generic.In-scope period: Policies bound in the current new business cycle and not yet billing-activated.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy status, policy number, written premium, effective date and contact name are recorded on the case.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Billing account premium equals policy written premium to the cent before activation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Confirmation is logged on the billing case with the policy contact name and a timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Policies not yet bound are logged as pending and re-checked before the next activation run.
generic.Test population: All new business billing activations completed in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero activations on a policy that is not in Bound or In Force status.
generic.Exception handling path: A premium mismatch stops activation and is referred to the Policy Administration Analyst for correction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Dated confirmation exists on the case referencing the in-force policy number.
generic.Evidence location: The new business billing case in the workflow case management tool and BillingCenter account history.

steps.title: Open the new business billing case in the workflow case management tool
sop: Open the pending activation case and read the policy number and requested effective date.
Confirm the case carries the billing account reference.
Note the assigned policy contact for the confirmation.
Done when the case shows policy number, billing account and policy contact.
verify: Check the case fields against the billing account in BillingCenter.
Pass when the case and account reference the same policy number.

steps.title: Confirm the policy is Bound or In Force in the policy administration system
sop: Open the policy and read the current status.
Confirm the status is Bound or In Force and not quoted, pending or withdrawn.
Record the status and the read date on the billing case.
Done when the policy status is confirmed and recorded on the case.
verify: Re-read the policy status immediately before activation.
Pass when the status remains Bound or In Force at the point of activation.

steps.title: Compare billing account premium to policy written premium in BillingCenter
sop: Read the total charges on the billing account.
Read written premium including taxes and fees from the policy system.
Compare both totals and record the result on the case.
Done when the two premium figures agree to the cent or a variance is raised.
verify: Recompute the difference between the two totals.
Pass when the difference is zero cents.

steps.title: Confirm the policy effective date equals the billing account start date in BillingCenter
sop: Read the billing account start date and the policy effective date.
Correct the billing account start date if it does not match.
Record the confirmed dates on the case.
Done when the two dates match on the record.
verify: Re-read both dates after any correction.
Pass when the billing account start date equals the policy effective date.

steps.title: Record the confirmation with contact name and timestamp on the billing case
sop: Log the confirmation naming the policy contact who confirmed activation.
Attach the policy status evidence and the premium comparison.
Timestamp the entry so the confirmation date is traceable.
Done when a dated confirmation entry naming the contact exists on the case.
verify: Open the case log and read the confirmation entry.
Pass when the entry carries the contact name, policy number and a timestamp.

steps.title: Activate the billing account in BillingCenter and close the activation case
sop: Activate the billing account so notice generation can select it.
Confirm the account status moves to active with the correct start date.
Close the activation case referencing the account activation entry.
Done when the account is active and the case is closed with a reference.
verify: Re-query the account status and the case closure record.
Pass when the account is active and the closed case references the activation.

generic.Defined scope/population: All released premium notices for the billing window split across paper, email and portal channels.
generic.In-scope period: The current notice distribution cycle from batch release to delivery acknowledgement.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each notice record carries a delivery channel, delivery address and a vendor or portal acknowledgement.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Print vendor return file count and dollar total match the released notice batch control totals.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Channel split extract and vendor acknowledgement files are retained with batch identifiers and dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Email bounce-backs are logged and re-queued to paper inside the notice lead time.
generic.Test population: All notices released in the distribution cycle across every channel.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero policies appearing in more than one delivery channel for the same billing cycle.
generic.Exception handling path: Undelivered notices are re-queued to paper by the Billing Specialist before the statutory deadline.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every released notice has one channel and a delivery acknowledgement recorded.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter notice history, vendor return files in the document repository and the Customer Self-Service Portal.

steps.title: Split the notice extract by delivery preference in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Extract the released notice batch and read the delivery preference on each account.
Split the extract into paper, email and portal-only files.
Confirm each policy appears in exactly one of the three files.
Done when the three channel files together equal the released batch with no duplicates.
verify: Sum the three channel file counts and compare to the batch count.
Pass when the channel counts sum to the batch count with no policy in two files.

steps.title: Exclude suppressed accounts from the distribution files in BillingCenter
sop: Identify lapsed, flat-cancelled and paid-in-full accounts in the batch.
Remove those accounts from all three channel files.
Record the suppression count and reason on the batch record.
Done when no suppressed account remains in any channel file.
verify: Re-scan the channel files for suppressed account statuses.
Pass when no cancelled, lapsed or paid-in-full account appears in a channel file.

steps.title: Transmit the paper file to the print vendor and reconcile the return file
sop: Transmit the paper channel file and record the transmission reference.
Load the vendor return file and read the accepted record count and dollar total.
Compare both to the released batch control totals.
Done when the vendor return totals match the released paper batch totals.
verify: Recompute the vendor count and dollar difference.
Pass when the vendor return count and dollar total equal the released totals.

steps.title: Capture email bounce-backs and re-queue affected policies to paper in BillingCenter
sop: Load the e-delivery bounce report for the batch.
Re-queue each bounced policy into the paper channel.
Confirm the re-queue still lands inside the statutory notice lead time.
Done when every bounced policy is re-queued to paper within the lead time.
verify: Check the re-queued policies appear on the follow-up paper run.
Pass when no bounced policy is left without a paper notice inside the lead time.

steps.title: Confirm portal-only statements are visible in the Customer Self-Service Portal
sop: Sample portal-only accounts from the batch on the release date.
Open each sampled account in the portal and confirm the statement is posted.
Log any account with no posted statement for reprocessing.
Done when sampled portal-only accounts show a posted statement on the release date.
verify: Re-check any account logged for reprocessing after the fix.
Pass when every portal-only account in the sample shows a posted statement.

steps.title: File delivery acknowledgements for the batch in the document management repository
sop: File the vendor acknowledgement, e-delivery report and portal posting evidence for the batch.
Index the pack by batch identifier and billing window.
Confirm every released notice maps to an acknowledgement in the pack.
Done when the acknowledgement pack is filed and complete for the batch.
verify: Retrieve the pack by batch identifier and sample notices against it.
Pass when every sampled notice has a channel and an acknowledgement in the pack.

generic.Defined scope/population: Newly bound policies that require a billing account, payment plan and payment schedule.
generic.In-scope period: Policies bound in the current new business setup cycle awaiting a billing account.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Account holder name, mailing address, payment plan, first due date and legal entity code are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Opening account balance equals policy written premium with zero prior transactions.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Account creation entry with user and timestamp is retained in BillingCenter account history.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Duplicate search hits are logged with the decision to merge, reuse or reject the new account.
generic.Test population: All billing accounts created during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero duplicate active billing accounts for the same policy number.
generic.Exception handling path: A duplicate account is closed by the Billing Specialist and its transactions moved to the surviving account.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Account is linked to the bound policy with plan, first due date and opening balance equal to written premium.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter billing account record and the policy declarations in the policy administration system.

steps.title: Run a duplicate billing account search in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Search BillingCenter on policy number, insured name and mailing address.
Review any near match to decide whether an account already exists.
Log the search result and decision before creating a new account.
Done when the duplicate search is complete and the decision is logged.
verify: Repeat the search after account creation.
Pass when only one active billing account exists for the policy number.

steps.title: Read the policy declarations from the policy administration system
sop: Open the bound policy and read insured name, mailing address and writing company.
Read written premium, taxes, fees and the elected billing mode.
Pass the declaration values to the billing specialist for account creation.
Done when the declaration values are recorded on the setup case.
verify: Compare the recorded values to the declarations page.
Pass when the recorded values match the policy declarations exactly.

steps.title: Create the billing account keyed to the policy number in BillingCenter
sop: Create the account with the policy number as the account key.
Enter the account holder name and mailing address from the declarations.
Save the account and record the account number on the setup case.
Done when the account exists with holder name and address matching declarations.
verify: Compare the saved account holder name and address to the declarations.
Pass when both match the policy declarations.

steps.title: Set the payment plan, first due date and installment count in BillingCenter
sop: Select the payment plan matching the elected billing mode.
Set the first due date consistent with the policy effective date.
Generate the installment schedule and confirm the installment count.
Done when the plan, first due date and installment count are set on the account.
verify: Read the generated schedule and total the installments.
Pass when the schedule total equals written premium and the count matches the plan.

steps.title: Confirm currency, billing entity and legal entity code match the writing company
sop: Read the writing company and legal entity from the policy record.
Set the account currency, billing entity and legal entity code to match.
Correct any mismatch before the account is released.
Done when entity and currency values on the account match the writing company.
verify: Compare the account entity fields to the policy writing company.
Pass when currency, billing entity and legal entity code all match.

steps.title: Confirm the opening balance equals written premium in BillingCenter
sop: Read the account opening balance after schedule generation.
Confirm no prior payments, credits or adjustments exist on the account.
Compare the opening balance to policy written premium.
Done when the opening balance equals written premium with no prior transactions.
verify: List all transactions on the new account.
Pass when the only transactions are the generated charges totalling written premium.

generic.Defined scope/population: Billing accounts due a first bill and awaiting a first-bill data record for notice production.
generic.In-scope period: Accounts activated in the current cycle whose first installment falls in the notice window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, insured name, due date, installment amount, itemised lines and remittance reference are set.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: First-bill record total equals the first installment on the billing account schedule.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Generated first-bill extract and rejection log are retained in the document repository with run date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Records with a null due date, zero amount or missing address are logged and reworked before release.
generic.Test population: All first-bill records generated in the production run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero released records with a null due date or a zero premium amount.
generic.Exception handling path: A rejected record is corrected by the Billing Specialist and regenerated in the same run window.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Record carries policy number, due date, itemised premium lines and a remittance reference.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter first-bill extract and the retained record image in the document management repository.

steps.title: Select first-bill eligible accounts in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Select activated accounts whose first installment falls in the notice window.
Exclude accounts already carrying a released first bill.
Record the selected account count as the run control total.
Done when the eligible population and its count are fixed for the run.
verify: Recount the eligible accounts from the account master.
Pass when the selected count equals the independently recounted eligible population.

steps.title: Generate the first-bill data record in BillingCenter
sop: Run the first-bill generation job over the selected population.
Confirm each record carries policy number, insured name, due date, amount and total premium.
Read the job log for generation failures.
Done when a record exists for every selected account or the failure is logged.
verify: Compare generated record count to the selected account count.
Pass when the two counts agree or every difference appears on the failure log.

steps.title: Confirm taxes, surcharges and disclosed items appear as distinct lines on the record
sop: Sample records carrying taxes, surcharges or separately disclosed premium.
Confirm each appears on its own line rather than folded into base premium.
Correct the template mapping where any item is folded in.
Done when sampled records show each charge type on a distinct line.
verify: Sum the itemised lines and compare to the record total.
Pass when itemised lines sum to the record total with each charge type separate.

steps.title: Reconcile the record total to the first installment on the BillingCenter schedule
sop: Extract the first installment amount for each account from the schedule.
Compare it to the total on the generated first-bill record.
List every variance for correction before release.
Done when record totals equal first installment amounts across the population.
verify: Recompute the variance list after corrections.
Pass when zero records differ from the scheduled first installment.

steps.title: Confirm the remittance address and payment reference are present on each record
sop: Check the remittance address block and the payment reference field on each record.
Confirm the reference is the value the cash application team keys against.
Flag records with a missing address or reference.
Done when every record carries a remittance address and a keyable payment reference.
verify: Key a sample reference into BillingCenter cash entry.
Pass when the sampled reference resolves to the correct billing account.

steps.title: Reject and rework defective records before release in BillingCenter
sop: Filter records with a null due date, zero amount or missing mailing address.
Hold those records out of the release and correct the source data.
Regenerate the corrected records and re-check them.
Done when no defective record remains in the release population.
verify: Re-run the defect filter over the release population.
Pass when the filter returns zero records with a null due date or zero amount.

steps.title: File the released first-bill extract in the document management repository
sop: Export the released first-bill extract and the rejection log.
File both in the document repository indexed by run date.
Record the run control totals alongside the extract.
Done when the extract, rejection log and control totals are filed together.
verify: Retrieve the run pack from the repository by run date.
Pass when the retrieved pack contains the extract, rejection log and control totals.

generic.Defined scope/population: In-force policies with an installment due in the notice generation window.
generic.In-scope period: The due-date window covered by the current premium notice generation run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each notice shows prior balance, current charges, payments applied and amount now due.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Notice batch premium total ties to billing ledger installments due for that window.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Batch control totals, exception report and released notice images are retained with the run date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed notices on the batch exception report are logged and reprocessed before the mailing deadline.
generic.Test population: All notices produced in the generation run for the due-date window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero notices produced for policies cancelled flat or already paid in full.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed notices are corrected and regenerated by the Billing Specialist inside the statutory window.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Batch has a reconciled control total and every selected policy has a produced notice.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter notice batch record and the notice images in the document management repository.

steps.title: Run the notice generation job for the due-date window in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Set the due-date window parameters for the run.
Execute the notice generation job and capture the selected policy count.
Compare the selected count to the expected in-force cohort for the window.
Done when the job completes and the selected count is captured.
verify: Recount in-force policies with an installment due in the window.
Pass when the selected policy count equals the expected in-force cohort.

steps.title: Reconcile the batch premium total to installments due in the billing ledger
sop: Total the premium on the generated notice batch.
Extract installments due in the same window from the billing ledger.
Compare the two totals and investigate any difference before release.
Done when the batch total equals installments due for the window.
verify: Recompute the difference between batch total and ledger installments due.
Pass when the difference is zero.

steps.title: Check notice content shows balance, charges, payments and amount due
sop: Sample notices across products and billing modes from the batch.
Confirm each shows prior balance, current charges, payments applied and amount now due.
Correct the template mapping where any element is missing.
Done when sampled notices display all four elements.
verify: Recompute amount now due from the displayed components on a sample notice.
Pass when the displayed amount due equals prior balance plus charges less payments.

steps.title: Confirm suppression of paid, cancelled and lapsing policies in BillingCenter
sop: List policies in the batch that are paid in full, flat cancelled or in active lapse processing.
Remove those policies from the batch before release.
Record the suppression counts on the batch record.
Done when no suppressed policy remains in the batch.
verify: Re-scan the batch for suppressed statuses after removal.
Pass when zero cancelled or paid-in-full policies remain in the batch.

steps.title: Work the batch exception report and reprocess failed notices in BillingCenter
sop: Open the batch exception report and categorise each failure.
Correct the source data and regenerate each failed notice.
Confirm the regeneration lands before the statutory mailing deadline.
Done when every exception is resolved or explicitly deferred with a reason.
verify: Re-run the exception report after reprocessing.
Pass when the exception report shows zero unresolved failures for the batch.

steps.title: Approve and release the notice batch to print in BillingCenter
sop: Review the reconciled control totals, suppression counts and exception clearance.
Approve the batch for release to the print and delivery process.
Record the approval and release time on the batch record.
Done when the batch is released with a recorded approval.
verify: Open the batch record after release.
Pass when the batch shows a reconciled control total and a named release approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: All billing setup and maintenance transactions that must write an audit trail entry.
generic.In-scope period: Billing setup changes made during the current audit review period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each audit entry carries user ID, timestamp, field changed, old value and new value.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Audit entry count equals the count of billing setup transactions for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Audit extract and linked source request documents are retained with extraction date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Transactions with no matching audit entry are logged and referred for system remediation.
generic.Test population: All billing setup transactions in the audited period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero setup changes attributed to a shared or generic account.
generic.Exception handling path: A missing audit entry is escalated by the Billing Operations Manager to the platform owner.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every setup change shows before and after values with a named user ID.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter audit trail extract and the source request documents in the document repository.

steps.title: Extract billing setup audit entries for the period from Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Run the audit extract filtered to billing setup and maintenance transaction types.
Include user ID, timestamp, field changed, old value and new value columns.
Save the extract with the run date for review.
Done when the audit extract for the period is produced and saved.
verify: Open the extract and check the required columns are populated.
Pass when no extract row has a blank user ID or timestamp.

steps.title: Reconcile audit entry count to billing setup transaction count in BillingCenter
sop: Count billing setup transactions posted in the period.
Count audit entries in the extract for the same period.
List transactions with no matching audit entry.
Done when the counts agree or every gap is listed.
verify: Recount both populations independently.
Pass when transaction and audit counts agree or every gap has a logged reason.

steps.title: Confirm payment-plan and bank-detail changes log as separate events
sop: Filter the extract for payment-plan and bank-detail change types.
Confirm each change appears as its own auditable event, not a bulk update.
Flag any bulk update that hides individual field changes.
Done when each change type is separately evidenced in the audit trail.
verify: Trace one plan change and one bank-detail change through the extract.
Pass when both appear as distinct entries with before and after values.

steps.title: Link each audit entry to its source request in the document management repository
sop: For sampled entries, locate the signed or emailed source request document.
Confirm the audit entry or case carries a link or reference to that document.
Add the missing reference where the link is absent.
Done when sampled audit entries reference a retrievable source document.
verify: Retrieve the source document from the repository using the recorded reference.
Pass when every sampled reference retrieves the correct source request.

steps.title: Spot-check that audit records cannot be edited or deleted by the setup user
sop: Review the BillingCenter role permissions applied to billing setup users.
Confirm no setup role carries audit edit or delete rights.
Attempt an audit edit under a setup role in the test environment.
Done when the permission review and the test attempt are documented.
verify: Read the outcome of the test attempt.
Pass when the setup role is denied audit edit and delete rights.

steps.title: Log generic-account attributions and file the review pack in the document repository
sop: Filter the extract for shared or generic account IDs.
Log each occurrence with the owning team and the remediation action.
File the extract, the gap list and the permission review in the repository.
Done when the review pack is filed and every generic attribution is logged.
verify: Retrieve the review pack and re-run the generic-account filter.
Pass when every generic attribution appears in the log with a disposition.

generic.Defined scope/population: All in-force policies and all billing accounts as at the same close date.
generic.In-scope period: The reconciliation close date covering the current billing and policy reporting period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each break row carries policy number, break type, amount, root cause, owner and target clearance date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Matched policy count plus break count equals the total policy and billing account population.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Both extracts and the reconciliation workbook are retained with the close date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unbilled exposures and billing orphans are logged with an owner and a clearance decision.
generic.Test population: All policies and billing accounts extracted as at the reconciliation close date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero in-force policies without an active billing account after clearance.
generic.Exception handling path: Unbilled exposures are routed to the Billing Specialist for immediate account setup.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reconciliation shows a matched population and an itemised break list with named owners.
generic.Evidence location: The reconciliation workbook in Microsoft Excel plus the source extracts from BillingCenter and the policy system.

steps.title: Extract the in-force policy file from the policy administration system
sop: Extract in-force policies as at the agreed close date with written premium and status.
Include cancelled and reinstated policies for the period with their status dates.
Save the extract with the close date in the filename.
Done when the in-force extract for the close date is produced.
verify: Check the extract record count against the policy system in-force count.
Pass when the extract count equals the reported in-force count for that date.

steps.title: Extract the billing account master as at the same close date from BillingCenter
sop: Extract active billing accounts with policy number, status and total scheduled installments.
Confirm the extract as-of date equals the policy extract close date.
Save the extract alongside the policy file.
Done when both extracts share the same close date.
verify: Compare the as-of dates on both extracts.
Pass when both extracts carry the identical close date.

steps.title: Match the two extracts on policy number in Microsoft Excel
sop: Join the policy and billing extracts on policy number.
Produce the matched set and the two unmatched sides.
Confirm matched plus unmatched equals the full population on both sides.
Done when the match is complete and the populations tie.
verify: Recount matched and unmatched rows against extract totals.
Pass when matched plus unmatched equals the total on each side.

steps.title: List unbilled exposures and billing orphans in the reconciliation workbook
sop: List in-force policies with no billing account as unbilled exposure.
List billing accounts with no in-force policy as billing orphans.
Record amount and age for each item.
Done when both lists are complete with amounts and ages.
verify: Sample items from both lists back to the source systems.
Pass when every sampled item is confirmed as a genuine break.

steps.title: Compare written premium to scheduled installments and list material variances
sop: For matched policies, compare policy written premium to total scheduled installments.
List variances above the materiality threshold.
Check cancelled and reinstated policies carry the matching billing status.
Done when the variance list and status mismatch list are produced.
verify: Recompute a sample of variances from the source records.
Pass when sampled variance amounts reproduce from the source systems.

steps.title: Log every break with root cause, owner and target clearance date
sop: Assign a root cause category and a named owner to every break.
Set a target clearance date consistent with the aging policy.
Circulate the break list to the named owners.
Done when no break row lacks a cause, owner and target date.
verify: Filter the break list for blank owner or target date.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Confirm clearance and file the reconciliation workbook for the close date
sop: Re-run the match after owners clear their breaks.
Confirm no in-force policy remains without an active billing account.
File the workbook and both extracts with the close date and version.
Done when the cleared reconciliation is filed for the close date.
verify: Retrieve the filed workbook and re-check the unbilled exposure list.
Pass when the cleared reconciliation shows zero unbilled in-force policies.

generic.Defined scope/population: Billing accounts where an authorised request redirects billing to a lienholder or third-party payor.
generic.In-scope period: Redirect requests effective from the next unbilled installment in the current cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Bill-to party, payor address, loan or account reference and authorisation document ID are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of redirected accounts equals the count of filed authorisation documents.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed request or lienholder clause is filed with a dated authorisation reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requests without evidenced authority are logged and rejected back to the requester.
generic.Test population: All third-party billing redirects applied during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero redirects existing without an authorisation document on file.
generic.Exception handling path: An unauthorised redirect is reversed by the Billing Specialist and the payor restored.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Bill-to party is the third-party payor with a filed written authorisation reference.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter billing account bill-to record and the authorisation document in the document repository.

steps.title: Obtain and file the signed request or lienholder clause in the document repository
sop: Collect the signed insured request or the lienholder clause evidencing billing authority.
File it in the document management repository indexed by policy number.
Record the authorisation document reference on the billing case.
Done when a retrievable authorisation reference exists on the case.
verify: Retrieve the document from the repository using the recorded reference.
Pass when the retrieved document evidences authority to bill the third party.

steps.title: Confirm the lienholder or additional interest on the policy record
sop: Open the policy and read the lienholder or mortgagee schedule.
Confirm the requested payor appears as an interest on the policy.
Return the confirmed payor name, address and loan reference to billing.
Done when the payor is confirmed against the policy interest schedule.
verify: Compare the requested payor to the policy interest schedule entry.
Pass when the payor matches an interest recorded on the policy.

steps.title: Set the bill-to party on the billing account in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Change the bill-to party to the lienholder or mortgagee.
Enter the payor address exactly as shown on the authorisation document.
Record the loan or account reference so the payor can match the bill.
Done when the bill-to party and address match the authorisation.
verify: Compare the saved bill-to address to the authorisation document.
Pass when the saved address matches the authorisation exactly.

steps.title: Keep the insured on the notice distribution as a courtesy copy in BillingCenter
sop: Check the state rule for insured courtesy copies on redirected billing.
Add the insured as a courtesy recipient where required.
Record the state rule applied on the case.
Done when the courtesy copy setting matches the state rule.
verify: Generate a sample notice and read the recipient list.
Pass when the recipient list matches the state courtesy copy requirement.

steps.title: Set the redirect to take effect from the next unbilled installment in BillingCenter
sop: Set the redirect effective date at the next unbilled installment.
Confirm an already-mailed notice is not reissued to the new payor.
Record the first installment that will bill to the third party.
Done when the effective date sits at the next unbilled installment.
verify: List notices issued after the change and check for duplicates.
Pass when no already-mailed installment was reissued to the new payor.

steps.title: Suppress privacy-sensitive fields on the third-party notice copy in BillingCenter
sop: Review the third-party notice template for privacy-sensitive fields.
Suppress fields the payor is not entitled to see.
Produce a sample third-party notice and review the output.
Done when the sample third-party notice shows no suppressed field.
verify: Compare the third-party sample to the insured copy.
Pass when privacy-sensitive fields appear only on the insured copy.

generic.Defined scope/population: New business policies bound in the period and the billing accounts activated against them.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period from the first to the last business day of the new business cohort.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Report carries bound counts, activated counts, SLA breaches, product line and billing mode splits.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Activated premium in the report equals billing ledger new-business premium for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report version and the underlying warehouse extract are retained with the period end date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Accounts still awaiting activation past SLA are listed with an owner and expected date.
generic.Test population: All new business policies bound during the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero unreconciled variance between reported activated premium and the billing ledger.
generic.Exception handling path: A reconciliation variance is investigated by the Accountant before the report is distributed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Report shows bound versus activated counts by day and reconciles to the billing ledger.
generic.Evidence location: The BI reporting platform report definition and the extract in the enterprise data warehouse.

steps.title: Extract bound policies and activated billing accounts to the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Extract policies bound in the period with bind date and premium.
Extract billing accounts activated in the period with activation date.
Load both into the warehouse tables used by the report.
Done when both extracts are loaded for the reporting period.
verify: Compare loaded row counts to the source system counts.
Pass when loaded counts equal the source counts for the period.

steps.title: Build the bound-versus-activated gap view by day in the BI reporting platform
sop: Chart bound policies against activated accounts for each business day.
Compute the daily gap and the cumulative unactivated count.
Highlight days where the gap exceeds the agreed tolerance.
Done when the daily gap view is built for the full period.
verify: Recompute one day of the gap from the warehouse extract.
Pass when the recomputed daily gap matches the report figure.

steps.title: Add first-notice issuance rate and SLA breach counts to the report
sop: Compute the share of activated accounts that produced a first notice.
Count accounts still awaiting activation past the activation SLA.
List those accounts with owner and expected activation date.
Done when issuance rate and SLA breach list are on the report.
verify: Sample an SLA breach account back to BillingCenter.
Pass when the sampled account is genuinely unactivated past SLA.

steps.title: Break the cohort down by product line and billing mode in the BI platform
sop: Split bound and activated counts by product line.
Split activated accounts by billing mode so EFT take-up is visible.
Confirm the splits sum to the cohort totals.
Done when both breakdowns are present and sum to the totals.
verify: Sum the breakdown rows and compare to the cohort totals.
Pass when each breakdown sums exactly to the cohort total.

steps.title: Reconcile activated premium to billing ledger new-business premium
sop: Extract new-business premium from the billing ledger for the period.
Compare it to activated premium reported in the BI platform.
Investigate and document any difference before distribution.
Done when the two premium figures agree or the difference is explained.
verify: Recompute the reconciliation from both sources.
Pass when the report and ledger premium agree or a documented reconciling item exists.

steps.title: Distribute the report to finance and operations leadership by the deadline
sop: Add commentary calling out SLA breaches and adverse trends.
Publish the report from the BI platform to the agreed distribution list.
Record the distribution date and the report version.
Done when the report is distributed by the agreed working-day deadline.
verify: Check the publication log for the report version and date.
Pass when the log shows distribution on or before the agreed deadline.

generic.Defined scope/population: Policyholders electing EFT who require an ACH debit authorisation before the first draft.
generic.In-scope period: Authorisations captured in the current setup cycle prior to their first scheduled draft.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Authorisation ID, debit amount basis, frequency, start date and revocation path are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of active draft schedules equals the count of retrievable signed or assented authorisations.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed or assented authorisation is stored with a dated authorisation ID and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed pre-notifications and validation return codes are logged with the corrective action.
generic.Test population: All EFT mandates activated in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero live draft schedules without a retrievable authorisation record.
generic.Exception handling path: A failed account validation blocks the mandate until corrected bank details are supplied.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Active mandate carries an authorisation ID, disclosed amount and a successful account validation.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter mandate record, Payment Gateway validation log and the authorisation in the document repository.

steps.title: Capture the signed or electronically assented ACH debit authorisation
sop: Collect the signed form or capture the electronic assent with its audit record.
Store it in the document management repository with a unique authorisation ID.
Record the authorisation ID on the billing account mandate.
Done when the mandate carries a retrievable authorisation ID.
verify: Retrieve the authorisation from the repository using the mandate reference.
Pass when the authorisation retrieves and shows the payor signature or assent record.

steps.title: Confirm the authorisation discloses amount, frequency and start date
sop: Read the authorisation text and confirm it states the debit amount or how it is calculated.
Confirm it states the debit frequency and the effective start date.
Reject and re-collect any authorisation missing a required disclosure.
Done when all three disclosures are present on the filed authorisation.
verify: Compare the disclosed values to the mandate configured in BillingCenter.
Pass when disclosed amount basis, frequency and start date match the mandate.

steps.title: Run a pre-notification or account validation in the Payment Gateway
sop: Submit the pre-notification or account validation for the tokenised bank account.
Read the response and record any ACH return code received.
Hold the mandate inactive where a return code is returned.
Done when validation returns no ACH return code or the mandate is held.
verify: Read the validation response stored against the mandate.
Pass when the stored response shows a clean validation before the first live draft.

steps.title: Set the draft date allowing for settlement days in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Set the draft date so funds settle on or before the premium due date.
Allow the standard ACH settlement days plus any weekend or holiday shift.
Confirm the calculated first draft date on the mandate.
Done when the first draft date settles on or before the due date.
verify: Recompute the settlement date from the draft date and settlement days.
Pass when the computed settlement date is not after the premium due date.

steps.title: Configure and disclose the revocation path in BillingCenter
sop: Confirm the mandate can be revoked in BillingCenter without a code change.
Confirm the payor communication states how to revoke and the notice required.
Test a revocation in the test environment and confirm drafts stop.
Done when the revocation path is configured and disclosed to the payor.
verify: Read the revocation disclosure sent to the payor.
Pass when the disclosure states the revocation method and it works in test.

steps.title: Activate the mandate in BillingCenter and reconcile mandates to authorisations
sop: Activate the mandate once validation and disclosures are complete.
Extract active mandates and compare to filed authorisation IDs.
Deactivate any mandate with no retrievable authorisation.
Done when every active mandate maps to a filed authorisation.
verify: Re-run the mandate to authorisation comparison.
Pass when zero active mandates lack a retrievable authorisation.

generic.Defined scope/population: Billing accounts with a payor change request for lienholder-pay or third-party-pay arrangements.
generic.In-scope period: Payor change requests processed before the next premium notice generation cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Payor name, mailing address, remittance identifier, effective date and prior payor end date are set.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of updated payor records equals the count of verified change requests processed.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Lienholder clause or signed authorisation is filed with the change effective date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requests without a lienholder clause or authorisation are logged and returned to the requester.
generic.Test population: All payor record updates applied during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero payor records overwritten without retaining the superseded values.
generic.Exception handling path: An unsupported change is reversed by the Billing Specialist and the prior payor reinstated.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Payor record shows the new third party with an effective date and the prior payor end-dated.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter payor history and the authorisation document in the document management repository.

steps.title: Verify the change request against the lienholder clause or signed authorisation
sop: Read the change request and locate the supporting lienholder clause or authorisation.
Confirm the document names the requested payor and the policy.
Reject the request where no supporting document exists.
Done when the request is matched to a supporting document or rejected.
verify: Retrieve the supporting document from the document repository.
Pass when the retrieved document supports the exact payor requested.

steps.title: Confirm the loan or account number against the policy record
sop: Open the policy and read the lienholder loan or account reference.
Compare it to the reference on the change request.
Return the confirmed reference to the billing specialist.
Done when the loan reference is confirmed against the policy.
verify: Compare the confirmed reference to the lienholder document.
Pass when the policy, the request and the document carry the same reference.

steps.title: Update payor name, address and remittance identifier in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Enter the new payor name and mailing address from the authorisation.
Enter the remittance identifier and loan or account number.
Set the change effective date on the payor record.
Done when the new payor details are saved with an effective date.
verify: Compare the saved payor details to the authorisation document.
Pass when the saved details match the authorisation field for field.

steps.title: End-date the prior payor rather than deleting it in BillingCenter
sop: Set an end date on the prior payor record.
Confirm the prior payor remains visible in payor history.
Confirm historical notices still resolve to the prior payor.
Done when the prior payor is end-dated and still retrievable.
verify: Open the payor history on the account.
Pass when the superseded payor is retained with an end date.

steps.title: Reissue the current open notice to the new payor where it is unpaid
sop: Check whether the current open notice has been paid.
Reissue it to the new payor only where it remains unpaid.
Record the reissue decision on the change case.
Done when the reissue decision is made and recorded.
verify: List notices issued to the new payor after the change.
Pass when no already-paid notice was reissued to the new payor.

steps.title: Confirm the change appears on the next generated premium notice
sop: Generate a preview of the next premium notice for the account.
Confirm the payor block shows the new third-party payor.
Correct the record before the cycle releases if the old payor still shows.
Done when the preview notice shows the new payor.
verify: Read the payor block on the released notice after the cycle runs.
Pass when the released notice is addressed to the new payor.

generic.Defined scope/population: Billing accounts requiring premium synchronisation against the policy administration system.
generic.In-scope period: The validation window running from the last endorsement cycle to the next notice generation run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Total charges, charge types, endorsement adjustments and remaining schedule are populated on the account.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Policy written premium including endorsements equals billing account total charges to the cent.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The validation result and the comparison workbook are retained with the validation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Endorsements with no matching billing adjustment are logged and routed for correction.
generic.Test population: All billing accounts validated in the current synchronisation run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero endorsements in the policy system without a corresponding billing adjustment.
generic.Exception handling path: A premium mismatch is corrected by the Billing Specialist before the next notice generation run.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Validation record shows policy written premium equal to billing account total charges.
generic.Evidence location: The comparison workbook in Microsoft Excel plus BillingCenter and policy system premium screens.

steps.title: Extract policy written premium including endorsements from the policy system
sop: Extract written premium with all endorsements applied to date.
Include taxes, fees and surcharges as separate columns.
Provide the extract to the billing specialist for comparison.
Done when the premium extract with endorsements is produced.
verify: Compare extract totals to the policy system premium summary.
Pass when the extract totals equal the policy system summary.

steps.title: Extract billing account total charges by charge type from BillingCenter
sop: Extract total charges split by premium, tax, fee and surcharge charge types.
Use the same as-of date as the policy extract.
Load both extracts into the comparison workbook.
Done when both extracts are loaded on a common as-of date.
verify: Check the as-of dates on both extracts.
Pass when both extracts share the same as-of date.

steps.title: Compare written premium to billing total charges in Microsoft Excel
sop: Join the extracts on policy number and compute the premium difference.
List every account with a non-zero difference.
Rank the differences by size for investigation.
Done when the difference list is produced for the population.
verify: Recompute the total difference across the population.
Pass when accounts in agreement show a zero cent difference.

steps.title: Confirm each tax, fee and surcharge mirrors as a separate charge type
sop: Compare policy tax, fee and surcharge amounts to the billing charge types.
Flag any item folded into base premium on the billing side.
Correct the charge type mapping for flagged items.
Done when every policy charge type has a matching billing charge type.
verify: Re-extract the charge type comparison after corrections.
Pass when each policy charge type maps to a distinct billing charge type.

steps.title: Verify the latest endorsement produced a matching billing adjustment
sop: List endorsements posted since the last validation with effective dates.
Match each to a billing adjustment transaction with the same effective date.
Log endorsements with no matching adjustment for correction.
Done when every endorsement is matched or logged as an exception.
verify: Recheck the exception list after corrections are posted.
Pass when no endorsement remains without a matching billing adjustment.

steps.title: Confirm remaining installments sum to the unbilled balance in BillingCenter
sop: Total the remaining installments on the schedule.
Compare to the unbilled balance on the account.
Correct rounding drift on the final installment where required.
Done when remaining installments equal the unbilled balance.
verify: Recompute the schedule total after any rounding correction.
Pass when the schedule total equals the unbilled balance with no residual cent.

steps.title: Record the validation result on the billing account before the next notice run
sop: Record the validation outcome and date on the billing account.
Attach the comparison workbook reference to the record.
Release the account for the next notice generation run.
Done when the validation result is recorded before notice generation.
verify: Read the validation entry on the account.
Pass when the entry is dated before the next notice generation run.

generic.Defined scope/population: Receipts that settle less than the full amount due on a billing account installment.
generic.In-scope period: Partial receipts posted during the current cash application day.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Applied installment, applied amount, short-pay reason code and recalculated balance are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Applied amounts plus remaining balance equal the account balance before the receipt.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Remittance advice and the application detail are retained against the receipt with a posting timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Short-pays outside tolerance are logged with the reason code and the follow-up action.
generic.Test population: All partial receipts posted in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero partial receipts left unapplied on the account after posting.
generic.Exception handling path: A misapplied partial payment is reversed by the Cash Application Specialist and reposted the same day.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Receipt is applied to specific installments with a recalculated balance and a short-pay reason code.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter receipt application detail and the ledger posting in the ERP general ledger.

steps.title: Read the remittance advice and identify the target installments in BillingCenter
sop: Open the receipt and read any remittance advice or notice stub reference.
List the open installments on the billing account in due-date order.
Note any customer direction on which installment to settle.
Done when the target installments are identified for the receipt.
verify: Compare the identified installments to the remittance advice.
Pass when the target installments match the customer direction or the oldest open items.

steps.title: Apply the receipt oldest-item-first in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Apply the receipt against the oldest open installment first unless directed otherwise.
Carry any residual to the next open installment in date order.
