Do not leave any part of the receipt unapplied on the account.
Done when the full receipt is applied across open installments.
verify: Read the unapplied amount on the receipt after posting.
Pass when the unapplied amount on the receipt is zero.

steps.title: Confirm the payment hierarchy applies fees and taxes before base premium
sop: Read the configured payment hierarchy for the account.
Confirm fees and taxes are settled ahead of base premium as documented.
Correct the application where the hierarchy was not followed.
Done when the application follows the documented hierarchy.
verify: Trace the application detail against the hierarchy definition.
Pass when charge types are settled in the documented order.

steps.title: Recalculate remaining balance and next amount due in BillingCenter
sop: Refresh the account after posting and read the remaining balance.
Read the next amount due and next due date.
Compare the remaining balance to the pre-posting balance less the receipt.
Done when the recalculated balance reconciles to the receipt applied.
verify: Recompute prior balance less applied amount.
Pass when the recomputed figure equals the displayed remaining balance.

steps.title: Code the short-pay reason on the receipt in BillingCenter
sop: Select the reason code for partial remittance, disputed fee or omitted installment fee.
Record a short note explaining the shortfall where the code is generic.
Confirm the code flows to aging and collections reporting.
Done when the receipt carries a short-pay reason code.
verify: Filter the day receipts for partial applications without a reason code.
Pass when the filter returns no partial receipt lacking a reason code.

steps.title: Check the de-minimis tolerance to prevent a false lapse in BillingCenter
sop: Compare the residual shortfall to the de-minimis tolerance.
Suppress the non-pay workflow where the shortfall is inside tolerance.
Escalate the account for outreach where the shortfall exceeds tolerance.
Done when the lapse decision reflects the tolerance rule.
verify: List accounts entering non-pay workflow with a shortfall inside tolerance.
Pass when no account inside tolerance entered the non-pay workflow.

steps.title: Confirm the ledger posting for the partial receipt in the ERP general ledger
sop: Confirm the receipt posted to cash and premium receivable per the posting map.
Confirm fee and tax portions posted to their own accounts.
Investigate any suspense residual created by the partial application.
Done when the ledger reflects the partial application with no residual suspense.
verify: Compare the ledger entry amount to the applied receipt amount.
Pass when the ledger entry equals the applied amount with no unexplained suspense.

generic.Defined scope/population: Captured receipts awaiting application to a policy or billing account record.
generic.In-scope period: Receipts captured on the current cash application business date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Match identifier, receipt date, amount, payment method and billing account are populated on each receipt.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Posted receipt count and total equal the captured receipt count and total for the day.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Remittance stub image and the match evidence are retained with the posting timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Receipts that cannot be matched with certainty are logged and routed to premium suspense.
generic.Test population: All receipts applied to policy records during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero receipts posted on name similarity alone without an amount and reference match.
generic.Exception handling path: An uncertain match is sent to suspense by the Cash Application Specialist rather than force-posted.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each posted receipt carries a system match identifier and a receipt date equal to the bank date.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter receipt application record and the policy premium-paid-to-date in the policy system.

steps.title: Match receipts to billing accounts on the remittance reference in BillingCenter
sop: Key the policy number or remittance reference from the notice stub.
Confirm the reference resolves to a single billing account.
Record the system match identifier on the receipt.
Done when the receipt is matched to one billing account by reference.
verify: Re-query the match identifier on the receipt.
Pass when the identifier resolves to exactly one billing account.

steps.title: Match on payor name, amount and due date where the reference is missing
sop: Search open accounts on payor name, exact amount and due date.
Require at least two corroborating attributes before accepting the match.
Record which attributes corroborated the match on the receipt.
Done when a corroborated match is recorded or the item is sent to suspense.
verify: Read the corroborating attributes recorded on the receipt.
Pass when no receipt shows a name-only match.

steps.title: Confirm posted amount, receipt date and method equal the bank record
sop: Compare the posted amount to the lockbox or bank record.
Set the receipt date to the bank date rather than the keying date.
Confirm the payment method matches the bank channel.
Done when amount, date and method equal the bank record.
verify: Sample receipts against the bank deposit detail.
Pass when sampled receipts match the bank on amount, date and method.

steps.title: Route uncertain matches to premium suspense in BillingCenter
sop: Send any receipt without a corroborated match to premium suspense.
Record the research clues captured from the instrument on the suspense item.
Never force-post to a close-name policy to clear the queue.
Done when every uncertain receipt sits in suspense with research clues.
verify: Review posted receipts for weak match evidence.
Pass when every weakly evidenced item was routed to suspense instead of posted.

steps.title: Confirm the policy system reflects premium-paid-to-date after the interface runs
sop: Run or await the billing to policy posting interface.
Open sampled policies and read the premium-paid-to-date.
Investigate any policy where the date did not move.
Done when sampled policies show an updated premium-paid-to-date.
verify: Compare the paid-to date to the installments settled by the receipt.
Pass when the paid-to date reflects the settled installments.

steps.title: Reconcile applied receipts to captured receipts for the day in BillingCenter
sop: Total applied receipts and captured receipts for the business date.
List any captured receipt neither applied nor in suspense.
Clear the list before the day is closed.
Done when captured receipts equal applied receipts plus suspense items.
verify: Recompute the day totals from BillingCenter.
Pass when captured equals applied plus suspense with no residual.

generic.Defined scope/population: All inbound premium receipts from lockbox, ACH, card settlement and portal channels.
generic.In-scope period: Receipts received on the prior business day and loaded on the current processing day.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each receipt captures date, amount, payment method, payor name and source reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Loaded receipt count and dollar total per channel tie to the bank deposit advice.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Channel source files and bank deposit advices are retained with the processing date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unreadable lockbox images and screening holds are logged with the same-day action taken.
generic.Test population: All receipt files loaded during the processing day across every channel.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero prior-day receipt files left unloaded at end of day.
generic.Exception handling path: A screening hold parks the receipt unposted until the screening decision is recorded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Daily capture totals per channel tie to the bank deposit advice with no unloaded file.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter receipt register, Payment Gateway settlement files and the ERP bank clearing account.

steps.title: Pull the lockbox, ACH, card and portal files for the processing day
sop: Retrieve the lockbox file, ACH credit file, card settlement file and portal payment extract.
Confirm each file carries the expected prior-day date stamp.
Log any expected file that did not arrive.
Done when every expected channel file is retrieved or logged as missing.
verify: Compare retrieved files to the expected daily file inventory.
Pass when every expected file is retrieved or has a logged non-arrival.

steps.title: Load each channel file into Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Load each file into the receipt register under its channel code.
Read the load log for rejected records and correct them.
Confirm no file is loaded twice by checking the file reference.
Done when every retrieved file is loaded exactly once.
verify: List loaded file references for the day.
Pass when each file reference appears exactly once in the register.

steps.title: Reconcile per-channel counts and totals to the bank deposit advice
sop: Total loaded receipts by channel and compare to the deposit advice.
Investigate any count or dollar difference before posting.
Record the reconciliation result per channel.
Done when each channel ties to its deposit advice or the difference is explained.
verify: Recompute the channel differences from the register and advice.
Pass when each channel difference is zero or has a documented explanation.

steps.title: Confirm required receipt attributes are captured in BillingCenter
sop: Check date, amount, payment method, payor name and source reference on loaded receipts.
Re-key missing attributes from the source image where available.
Flag receipts that cannot be completed for suspense routing.
Done when loaded receipts carry all required attributes or are flagged.
verify: Filter the register for receipts with a blank required attribute.
Pass when the filter returns only receipts flagged for suspense.

steps.title: Hold sanctioned-country or unexpected foreign remittances for screening
sop: Identify receipts with foreign routing or an unexpected foreign remitter.
Hold each unposted and refer it for sanctions screening.
Record the screening referral reference on the receipt.
Done when every flagged receipt is held with a screening referral.
verify: List posted receipts with foreign routing indicators.
Pass when no flagged receipt was posted before screening cleared.

steps.title: Re-key rejected lockbox images the same day in BillingCenter
sop: List lockbox items rejected as unreadable.
Open each image and re-key the payor, amount and reference.
Confirm the re-keyed item enters the same-day register.
Done when every rejected image is re-keyed or logged with a reason.
verify: Re-run the rejected image list at day close.
Pass when no rejected image is carried to the next processing cycle.

generic.Defined scope/population: Policyholder self-service payment and auto-pay enrolment journeys in the customer portal.
generic.In-scope period: The current release window covering portal payment and enrolment configuration changes.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Enrolment writes mandate amount basis, draft date, cancel path and delivery preference to the account.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Portal enrolment count equals the count of active auto-pay mandates created on billing accounts.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Test evidence for enrolment, decline and same-day payment scenarios is retained with the release version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Declined enrolments are logged with the message shown and the account state left behind.
generic.Test population: All portal payment and enrolment test cases executed for the release.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero card or bank account numbers returned to the browser or written to application logs.
generic.Exception handling path: A declined payment leaves the account unpaid and routes the policyholder to a retry path.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Portal enrolment creates an active mandate with disclosed amount, draft date and cancel path.
generic.Evidence location: Customer Self-Service Portal test results, Payment Gateway logs and BillingCenter mandate records.

steps.title: Confirm the portal payment page posts to the tokenising Payment Gateway
sop: Trace the portal payment submission to the gateway endpoint.
Confirm the response returns a token and masked value only.
Confirm no full card or account number reaches the application tier.
Done when the payment page is confirmed to post only to the tokenising gateway.
verify: Inspect the gateway response payload and the application log entries.
Pass when neither the response nor the logs contain an unmasked number.

steps.title: Review the auto-pay enrolment disclosures in the Customer Self-Service Portal
sop: Walk the enrolment screen as a policyholder would.
Confirm the debit amount basis, draft date and cancel path appear before submission.
Raise any missing disclosure for correction before release.
Done when all three disclosures appear before the submit action.
verify: Re-walk the screen after any correction.
Pass when amount basis, draft date and cancel path are all shown pre-submit.

steps.title: Test that an enrolment writes an active mandate on the billing account
sop: Complete a test enrolment through the portal.
Open the billing account in BillingCenter and read the mandate record.
Confirm paper notice suppression where e-delivery was elected.
Done when the test enrolment produces an active mandate on the account.
verify: Compare the mandate values to the disclosures shown at enrolment.
Pass when the mandate amount basis and draft date match the disclosures.

steps.title: Test a declined card through the Payment Gateway and read the portal message
sop: Submit a test card that the gateway will decline.
Read the failure message presented to the policyholder.
Confirm the billing account is not marked paid.
Done when the decline path shows a clear message and leaves the account unpaid.
verify: Read the account balance and status after the declined attempt.
Pass when the account remains unpaid and the message states the failure.

steps.title: Test a same-day portal payment against a pending dunning step
sop: Select a test account with a pending dunning step.
Make a portal payment clearing the amount due.
Confirm the balance updates and the dunning step stops.
Done when the payment updates the balance and halts dunning.
verify: Re-run the dunning selection for that account.
Pass when the account no longer selects for the pending dunning step.

steps.title: Reconcile portal enrolments to active mandates and release the capability
sop: Compare portal enrolment counts to active mandates created in BillingCenter.
Investigate any enrolment with no mandate written.
Approve release once the test evidence pack is complete.
Done when counts agree and the capability is released.
verify: Re-run the enrolment to mandate comparison after release.
Pass when every portal enrolment has a matching active mandate.

generic.Defined scope/population: Receivable balances past the escalation threshold or at the final dunning step.
generic.In-scope period: The aging report as at the current escalation review date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each escalation carries balance, days past due, dunning history, last contact date and recommended action.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Escalated balance total ties to the aged receivable balance above the threshold.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Aging report version and escalation pack are retained with the review date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Disputes and unapplied-cash cases are logged and excluded from non-pay escalation.
generic.Test population: All accounts past the escalation threshold on the review date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero accounts with an open billing dispute escalated as non-pay cancellation candidates.
generic.Exception handling path: A dispute-flagged account is routed to billing research rather than collections escalation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every account past the threshold has a logged escalation with owner and recommended action.
generic.Evidence location: The BI aging report, BillingCenter dunning history and the escalation case in the workflow tool.

steps.title: Run the aging report in the BI reporting platform for the review date
sop: Run the receivables aging report as at the review date.
Select balances past the escalation threshold or at the final dunning step.
Save the report version used for the escalation run.
Done when the escalation candidate population is selected and saved.
verify: Recompute the candidate balance total from the aging report.
Pass when the selected total equals the aged balance above the threshold.

steps.title: Separate disputes and unapplied cash from genuine non-pay candidates
sop: Flag accounts with an open billing dispute case.
Flag accounts with unapplied cash or suspense items that would clear the balance.
Remove both groups from the non-pay escalation list.
Done when only genuine non-pay candidates remain on the list.
verify: Cross-check the remaining list against open dispute and suspense records.
Pass when no remaining account has an open dispute or clearing suspense item.

steps.title: Attach dunning history and last contact date from BillingCenter
sop: Extract the dunning stage history for each candidate account.
Extract the date and channel of the last customer contact attempt.
Add both to the escalation record for each account.
Done when every candidate shows dunning history and last contact date.
verify: Sample candidates and compare to BillingCenter dunning history.
Pass when sampled escalation records match the system dunning history.

steps.title: Flag accounts approaching a statutory cancellation-notice date
sop: Compute the statutory notice date for each candidate from its state rules.
Flag accounts where the notice deadline falls inside the next cycle.
Prioritise those accounts at the top of the escalation pack.
Done when notice-deadline accounts are flagged and prioritised.
verify: Compare flagged accounts to the statutory notice calendar.
Pass when every account with a near notice deadline is flagged.

steps.title: Log the escalation in the workflow case management tool
sop: Create an escalation case per account with balance and days past due.
Record the recommended action and assign a named owner.
Link the case to the aging report version used.
Done when every candidate has an escalation case with an owner.
verify: Filter escalation cases for blank owner or recommended action.
Pass when the filter returns no cases.

steps.title: Review and accept the escalation pack with collections management
sop: Review the escalation pack against the aging report totals.
Confirm exclusions for disputes and unapplied cash are justified.
Accept the pack and confirm the owners are notified.
Done when the pack is accepted and owners are notified.
verify: Re-total the accepted escalations against the aging threshold population.
Pass when every account above the threshold is either escalated or documented as excluded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Due installments on billing accounts carrying an active EFT or auto-pay mandate.
generic.In-scope period: The installments due in the current scheduled draft run window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Draft file carries account token, amount, settlement date and mandate reference for each item.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Draft file record count and dollar total balance to the installments-due extract.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Draft file, control totals and the bank transmission acknowledgement are retained with the run date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Excluded accounts and file rejects are logged with the reason and the next action.
generic.Test population: All installments selected into the scheduled draft run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero installments appearing in two consecutive draft files.
generic.Exception handling path: A rejected draft item is corrected and included in the next run rather than re-sent unchanged.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Run has a balanced control total and a retained bank transmission acknowledgement.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter draft run record, the Payment Gateway transmission log and the ERP cash posting.

steps.title: Select due installments with an active mandate in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Select installments due in the run window on accounts with an active mandate.
Exclude cancelled, lapsed and paid accounts from the selection.
Record the selected count and dollar total as the run control.
Done when the selection and its control totals are fixed.
verify: Re-run the eligibility query independently.
Pass when the independent count equals the selected count.

steps.title: Balance the draft file to the installments-due extract
sop: Build the draft file from the selected installments.
Compare file record count and dollar total to the extract control totals.
Investigate and correct any difference before transmission.
Done when the file balances to the installments-due extract.
verify: Recompute the file totals from the built file.
Pass when file count and dollars equal the extract control totals.

steps.title: Confirm the settlement date honours pre-notification and lead-time rules
sop: Read the effective settlement date set on the file.
Confirm each mandate has satisfied its pre-notification requirement.
Confirm the settlement date respects ACH lead-time and holiday rules.
Done when the settlement date is valid for every item in the file.
verify: Sample items and recompute their required earliest settlement date.
Pass when no item settles earlier than its permitted date.

steps.title: Transmit the draft file through the Payment Gateway to the bank
sop: Transmit the balanced draft file to the bank through the gateway.
Capture the transmission reference and the acknowledgement.
File the acknowledgement against the draft run record.
Done when the file is transmitted and the acknowledgement is filed.
verify: Compare the acknowledged record count to the transmitted count.
Pass when the bank acknowledgement matches the transmitted control totals.

steps.title: Post pending drafts as in-flight on the billing accounts in BillingCenter
sop: Mark the drafted installments as in-flight on each account.
Confirm the in-flight state excludes them from the next selection.
Confirm the ERP general ledger reflects the pending cash movement.
Done when every drafted installment is marked in-flight.
verify: Run the next selection query in preview mode.
Pass when no in-flight installment is selected by the next run.

steps.title: Review and sign off the draft run in BillingCenter
sop: Review the run control totals, exclusions and bank acknowledgement.
Confirm no installment appears in two consecutive draft files.
Record the sign-off against the draft run record.
Done when the run carries a recorded sign-off.
verify: Compare the current file to the prior run file for overlapping installments.
Pass when no installment appears in both files.

generic.Defined scope/population: All premium payment transactions requiring an entry in the payment ledger.
generic.In-scope period: Payments posted during the current accounting day within an open period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each entry records date, amount, source, policy reference, transaction ID and posting operator or batch.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Day total of ledger postings equals the day total of captured receipts.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Ledger extract and the posting map version are retained with the accounting date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Entries attempted into a closed period are logged and reposted to the current period with a reason.
generic.Test population: All payment ledger entries posted in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero ledger entries dated into a closed accounting period.
generic.Exception handling path: A posting error is corrected by an offsetting reversal plus a new entry retaining the original reference.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Entries carry date, amount, source, policy reference and a unique transaction ID.
generic.Evidence location: The ERP general ledger payment journal and the BillingCenter receipt register.

steps.title: Extract the day payment postings from Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Extract all payment transactions posted for the accounting date.
Include date, amount, source, policy reference and transaction ID.
Save the extract for ledger comparison.
Done when the day payment extract is produced.
verify: Check the extract for blank required columns.
Pass when no extract row has a blank amount, date or policy reference.

steps.title: Confirm GL account mapping against the posting map in the ERP general ledger
sop: Compare posted GL accounts to the cash, premium receivable and suspense mapping.
Flag any transaction posted outside the mapped accounts.
Correct the mapping or the posting for flagged items.
Done when every posting sits in a mapped GL account.
verify: Re-run the mapping check after corrections.
Pass when zero postings fall outside the posting map.

steps.title: Reconcile ledger posting totals to captured receipts for the day
sop: Total ledger payment postings for the date.
Total captured receipts for the same date.
Investigate any difference before the day is closed.
Done when the two totals agree or the difference is explained.
verify: Recompute both day totals independently.
Pass when posting and receipt totals agree with no unexplained difference.

steps.title: Confirm each entry carries the posting operator or batch identifier
sop: Check the operator or batch identifier on each ledger entry.
Investigate entries with a generic or blank identifier.
Record the resolution for any generic attribution.
Done when every entry shows an operator or batch identifier.
verify: Filter the ledger for blank or generic identifiers.
Pass when the filter returns no unresolved entries.

steps.title: Confirm no entry posts into a closed accounting period in the ERP
sop: Check each entry accounting date against the period status.
Repost late items to the current open period with a documented reason.
Record the reason on the reposted entry.
Done when every entry sits in an open accounting period.
verify: Re-run the closed-period check over the day entries.
Pass when zero entries carry a closed-period accounting date.

steps.title: Confirm corrections post as reversal plus new entry in the ERP general ledger
sop: List corrections made during the day.
Confirm each shows an offsetting reversal referencing the original transaction ID.
Confirm the replacement entry retains the original reference.
Done when every correction follows the reversal plus re-entry pattern.
verify: Trace one correction from original to reversal to replacement.
Pass when the chain is complete and the original entry was not edited in place.

generic.Defined scope/population: Flexible and unscheduled premium payments on universal life and annuity contracts.
generic.In-scope period: Deposits received in good order during the current processing day.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Good-order receipt date, allocation percentages, money type and contract status are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Allocated amounts sum to the deposit and allocation percentages total one hundred percent.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Limit test output and allocation instructions of record are retained with the deposit transaction.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Deposits breaching a contractual or tax limit are logged, quarantined and dispositioned.
generic.Test population: All flexible premium payments applied in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero deposits applied that breach a contractual maximum or tax-qualification limit.
generic.Exception handling path: A limit breach quarantines the deposit until the owner instruction to reduce or return is recorded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Deposit posts with a good-order receipt date and an allocation totalling one hundred percent.
generic.Evidence location: The contract transaction history in the policy administration system and the ERP premium posting.

steps.title: Confirm the contract permits an unscheduled premium in the policy administration system
sop: Open the contract and read the flexible premium provision.
Confirm the contract is in force and not in a restricted status.
Reject the deposit where the provision or status does not permit it.
Done when contract permission and status are confirmed.
verify: Re-read the contract status immediately before application.
Pass when the contract remains in force and permits unscheduled premium.

steps.title: Validate the payment against maximum premium and guideline limits
sop: Run the maximum premium test for the contract.
Run the guideline premium and seven-pay tests where applicable.
Quarantine the deposit where any test fails.
Done when the limit tests are run and their results are recorded.
verify: Read the retained limit test output on the deposit.
Pass when the deposit either passed all tests or is quarantined.

steps.title: Apply the deposit using the allocation instructions of record
sop: Read the allocation instructions of record on the contract.
Confirm the split percentages total one hundred percent.
Apply the deposit across the elected options accordingly.
Done when the deposit is allocated per the instructions of record.
verify: Sum the allocated amounts and the allocation percentages.
Pass when amounts sum to the deposit and percentages total one hundred percent.

steps.title: Set the crediting date to the good-order receipt date
sop: Read the good-order receipt date from the cash receipt record.
Set the crediting date on the contract transaction to that date.
Confirm the unit values used are those of the crediting date.
Done when the crediting date equals the good-order receipt date.
verify: Compare the crediting date and unit value date on the transaction.
Pass when both equal the good-order receipt date.

steps.title: Verify the updated accumulation value and cost basis on the contract
sop: Read the accumulation value after the deposit posts.
Confirm the increase equals the net deposit plus any crediting to that date.
Confirm cost basis moved only for after-tax money.
Done when accumulation value and cost basis reflect the deposit.
verify: Recompute prior value plus net deposit.
Pass when the recomputed value equals the posted accumulation value.

steps.title: Reconcile the contract deposit to the cash receipt in the ERP general ledger
sop: Match the contract deposit transaction to the cash receipt.
Confirm the GL premium posting equals the applied deposit.
Investigate any deposit with no corresponding cash.
Done when every deposit ties to a cash receipt and a GL posting.
verify: Re-run the deposit to cash match for the day.
Pass when no contract deposit exists without matching cash.

steps.title: Release the deposit confirmation to the owner from the policy system

Release the confirmation to the owner delivery preference of record.

generic.Defined scope/population: Employer list bill remittances received against the billed census for the group billing period.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Remitter, remittance amount, billing period, member identifiers and variance reasons are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Remitted total plus variance schedule equals the billed census total for the period.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Members billed but not remitted and rate differences are logged with the follow-up owner and date.
generic.Test population: All list bill remittances received for the billing period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero variances written off without a documented member-level explanation.
generic.Exception handling path: Unexplained residuals stay in suspense until the group administrator responds.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reconciliation shows billed total, remitted total and a member-level variance schedule.
generic.Evidence location: The reconciliation workbook in Microsoft Excel, BillingCenter group account and the ERP suspense account.

steps.title: Match the employer remittance total to the billed census total in BillingCenter
sop: Read the remittance total received for the billing period.
Read the billed census total for the same period on the group account.
Compute and record the variance.
Done when the variance between remitted and billed is quantified.
verify: Recompute the variance from both source figures.
Pass when the recomputed variance equals the recorded variance.

steps.title: Drill the variance to member level in Microsoft Excel
sop: Join the remittance detail to the billed census on member identifier.
List members billed but not remitted and remitted but not billed.
List members remitted at a rate different from the billed rate.
Done when the three member-level lists are produced.
verify: Sum the three lists and compare to the total variance.
Pass when the member-level lists account for the full variance.

steps.title: Separate census changes from payment errors
sop: Identify terminations and new hires appearing in the remittance.
Route those to census maintenance rather than payment research.
Record the census change requests raised.
Done when census-driven differences are separated from payment errors.
verify: Re-run the member-level lists after census updates are applied.
Pass when census-driven items no longer appear as payment variances.

steps.title: Apply the matched portion to member certificates in BillingCenter
sop: Apply the reconciled portion of the remittance to matched certificates.
Hold only the unexplained residual in suspense.
Confirm each certificate balance updates for the applied amount.
Done when the matched portion is applied and only the residual is held.
verify: Compare applied amount plus suspense residual to the remittance total.
Pass when applied plus residual equals the remittance received.

steps.title: Confirm the suspense residual posts to the ERP general ledger suspense account
sop: Confirm the residual posts to the mapped suspense account.
Confirm it is not posted to premium income.
Record the residual amount and age for reporting.
Done when the residual sits in the mapped suspense account.
verify: Read the GL suspense movement for the remittance.
Pass when the GL movement equals the held residual.

steps.title: Issue the variance schedule to the group administrator and log the follow-up
sop: Send the member-level variance schedule to the group administrator.
Request the missing remittance or a corrected census.
Log the follow-up date on the group account.
Done when the schedule is issued and a follow-up date is logged.
verify: Check the group account for the issued schedule and follow-up date.
Pass when both the issue record and the follow-up date are present.

generic.Defined scope/population: Prior-day premium clearing account bank items and the billing system receipt register.

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Clearing account closing balance equals unapplied receipts plus in-transit items.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Bank statement, receipt register and the signed reconciliation are retained with the reconciliation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unmatched bank credits are logged and routed to premium suspense with a reason.
generic.Test population: All bank deposits and receipt batches for the reconciled business date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero unexplained residual in the premium clearing account at day close.
generic.Exception handling path: An unidentified deposit is moved to premium suspense for research rather than left in clearing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reconciliation exists with preparer and independent reviewer sign-off.
generic.Evidence location: The ERP clearing account reconciliation, the bank statement and the BillingCenter receipt register.

steps.title: Pull the prior-day bank statement for the premium clearing account
sop: Retrieve the bank statement for the premium clearing account.
Confirm the statement date is the business date being reconciled.
List all deposits and credits with references.
Done when the statement items for the date are listed.
verify: Compare the statement opening balance to the prior reconciliation closing balance.
Pass when the opening balance carries forward without a gap.

steps.title: Extract the receipt register for the same date from Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Extract all receipt batches recorded for the business date.
Include batch reference, channel and dollar total.
Provide the register to the accountant for matching.
Done when the receipt register for the date is produced.
verify: Compare register totals to the day capture totals.
Pass when the register total equals the captured receipt total for the date.

steps.title: Match deposits to receipt batches in the ERP general ledger
sop: Match on amount and deposit reference between statement and register.
List unmatched bank items and unmatched receipt batches separately.
Record a reason against each unmatched item.
Done when both unmatched lists are produced with reasons.
verify: Sum matched plus unmatched on each side.
Pass when matched plus unmatched equals the total on both sides.

steps.title: Confirm the clearing balance equals unapplied receipts plus in-transit items
sop: Compute unapplied receipts and in-transit items as at the date.
Compare the sum to the clearing account closing balance.
Investigate any residual difference.
Done when the balance is explained by unapplied plus in-transit items.
verify: Recompute the explained balance from the supporting listings.
Pass when no unexplained residual remains in the clearing account.

steps.title: Route bank credits with no receipt to premium suspense in BillingCenter
sop: Identify direct wires and unidentified deposits with no receipt record.
Create a premium suspense item for each with the bank reference.
Record the suspense item reference on the reconciliation.
Done when every unmatched bank credit has a suspense item.
verify: Compare unmatched bank credit count to suspense items created.
Pass when every unmatched credit has a corresponding suspense item.

steps.title: Obtain independent review sign-off before day close in Microsoft Excel
sop: Review the completed reconciliation and the supporting listings.
Confirm the preparer is not the reviewer.
Sign and date the reconciliation and file it.
Done when the reconciliation carries preparer and reviewer sign-off.
verify: Read the sign-off block on the filed reconciliation.
Pass when preparer and reviewer are different named individuals.

generic.Defined scope/population: Cash collected for the day by channel and the outstanding premium receivable balance.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero unexplained difference between reported collections and bank deposits.

steps.title: Extract day collections by channel to the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Extract collections split by lockbox, ACH, card, wire and portal with counts and dollars.
Load the extract into the warehouse table feeding the daily report.
Confirm the extract covers the full collection day.
Done when the channel extract is loaded for the reporting day.
verify: Compare loaded totals to the BillingCenter receipt register.
Pass when loaded totals equal the register totals for the day.

steps.title: Compute outstanding receivable balance and day-on-day movement in the BI platform
sop: Compute total outstanding premium receivable as at the reporting date.
Compare it to the prior day balance and compute the movement.
Flag movements beyond the agreed tolerance.
Done when the balance and its movement are computed and flagged.
verify: Recompute the movement from the two day balances.
Pass when the reported movement equals prior balance less current balance.

steps.title: Reconcile the reported collection total to bank deposits
sop: Compare the reported collection total to the bank deposit total.
Identify and note timing differences such as late-cut deposits.
Hold distribution where a difference is unexplained.
Done when the report ties to bank deposits or timing differences are noted.
verify: Recompute the reconciliation from both sources.
Pass when every difference is either zero or a noted timing item.

steps.title: Add unapplied cash and suspense balances to the report
sop: Extract unapplied cash and premium suspense balances for the date.
Add both to the report so usable cash is distinguishable from held cash.
Confirm the suspense figure ties to the suspense subledger.
Done when unapplied and suspense balances appear on the report.
verify: Compare the reported suspense figure to the suspense subledger.
Pass when the reported figure equals the subledger balance.

steps.title: Write commentary for swings beyond tolerance in the BI reporting platform
sop: Review flagged day-on-day swings by channel.
Write a cause for each swing beyond tolerance.
Attach supporting detail where a single large item drove the swing.
Done when every flagged swing carries a written cause.
verify: Filter flagged swings for missing commentary.
Pass when no flagged swing lacks a written cause.

steps.title: Distribute the daily report to treasury and finance by the cut-off
sop: Publish the report to the treasury and finance distribution list.
Record the publication time against the agreed cut-off.
Retain the published version with the reporting date.
Done when the report is published before the daily cut-off.
verify: Read the publication log entry for the report.
Pass when the publication time is on or before the agreed cut-off.

generic.Defined scope/population: Open breaks identified on the premium clearing account bank reconciliation.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Break category, amount, age, clearing transaction reference and approval are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Cleared break value plus remaining open breaks equals the opening break population.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every cleared break records a root-cause category and the clearing transaction reference.

steps.title: Categorise each open break in the ERP general ledger break log
sop: Review each open break and assign a category.
Use timing, posting error, duplicate receipt, bank error or unidentified deposit.
Record the supporting evidence reference for the category chosen.
Done when every open break carries a category and evidence reference.
verify: Filter the break log for blank categories.
Pass when no open break lacks a category.

steps.title: Raise correcting entries for posting errors with authority approval
sop: Prepare the correcting entry referencing the original transaction ID.
Route it for approval per the journal authority matrix.
Post the entry once approved and record the reference on the break.
Done when each posting error has an approved correcting entry.

Pass when the entry references the original ID and carries an approval.

steps.title: Raise bank claims for bank errors and record the claim reference
sop: Raise the claim with the bank for each bank error break.
Record the claim reference and the expected resolution date on the break.
Chase the bank at the agreed follow-up interval.
Done when every bank error break carries a claim reference and expected date.
verify: Filter bank error breaks for missing claim references.
Pass when every bank error break shows a claim reference.

steps.title: Reverse duplicate receipts in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Identify the duplicate receipt and its original.
Reverse the duplicate referencing the original receipt.
Never net a duplicate against an unrelated item.
Done when the duplicate is reversed with a reference to the original.
verify: Read the reversal entry on the duplicate receipt.
Pass when the reversal references the original receipt and nets to zero.

steps.title: Escalate breaks aged beyond the published threshold to the receivables manager
sop: List breaks older than the published aging threshold.
Write a status for each covering cause, action taken and blocker.
Send the list to the receivables manager.
Done when every aged break is escalated with a written status.
verify: Compare the aged break list to the escalations sent.
Pass when no aged break is missing from the escalation.

steps.title: Confirm no break was cleared by a plug in the ERP general ledger
sop: Review clearing entries posted against the break log.
Identify any entry with no supporting transaction reference.
Reverse and rework any plug or unexplained write-off.
Done when every cleared break traces to a supported transaction.
verify: Sample cleared breaks and trace their clearing entries.
Pass when every sampled clearance references a supported transaction.

generic.Defined scope/population: ACH returns and card declines received against previously credited premium payments.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero mandates left active after a no-authorisation or account-closed return code.
generic.Exception handling path: A prohibited return fee is reversed and the account corrected before the next notice.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each return shows a reversal entry, a reason code and a customer notification record.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter reversal transactions, the Payment Gateway return file and the CRM notification record.

steps.title: Load the ACH return and card decline files from the Payment Gateway
sop: Retrieve the ACH return file and the card decline report for the day.
Load both into BillingCenter against the original receipts.
Record the file counts and values as the day control.
Done when both files are loaded and their controls recorded.
verify: Compare loaded item counts to the file header totals.
Pass when loaded counts equal the file header counts.

steps.title: Reverse the provisional credit on each affected account in BillingCenter
sop: Post a reversal against each returned receipt the same day.
Confirm the account balance returns to the pre-payment position.
Record the return reason code on the reversal.
Done when every returned item has a same-day reversal.
verify: Compare reversal totals to the return file totals.
Pass when reversal count and value equal the return file count and value.

steps.title: Work each return by code and deactivate mandates where required
sop: Route insufficient-funds and uncollected-funds codes to retry or outreach.
Deactivate the mandate immediately for account-closed and no-authorisation codes.
Record the action taken against each return code.
Done when every return has a code-appropriate action recorded.
verify: List active mandates against accounts with a prohibiting return code.
Pass when no mandate remains active after a prohibiting return code.

steps.title: Apply or suppress the returned-payment fee per the filed fee schedule
sop: Look up the returned-payment fee filed for the policy state.
Apply the fee where permitted and suppress it where prohibited.
Record the fee decision on the account.
Done when each account carries the correct fee treatment.
verify: Compare applied fees to the filed fee schedule by state.
Pass when no fee exceeds or contradicts the filed schedule.

steps.title: Notify the policyholder of the failed payment through the CRM
sop: Send the failed payment notification stating the amount and revised due date.
Use the delivery preference of record for the policyholder.
Log the notification against the customer record.
Done when every affected policyholder has a logged notification.
verify: Compare notification count to reversed payment count.
Pass when every reversed payment has a logged customer notification.

steps.title: Restore the account to the correct dunning stage in BillingCenter
sop: Reset the account to past-due status after the reversal.
Confirm the dunning stage reflects true days past due.
Confirm no account jumps straight to cancellation.
Done when each account sits at the correct dunning stage.
verify: Sample accounts and compare dunning stage to days past due.
Pass when no account advanced past its correct dunning stage.

generic.Defined scope/population: Flexible premium deposits requiring guideline premium, seven-pay and contribution limit testing.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero deposits applied that failed a limit test without documented resolution.
generic.Exception handling path: A failing deposit is held unapplied until the owner instructs reduction or return.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Limit test output is retained with the deposit and shows the parameters used.
generic.Evidence location: The contract transaction record in the policy system and the test workbook in Microsoft Excel.

steps.title: Extract deposits requiring limit testing to the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Extract flexible premium deposits for the period with contract and money type.
Include prior-year contributions received before the filing deadline.
Load the extract for testing.
Done when the tested population is extracted and loaded.
verify: Compare the extract count to deposits received for the period.
Pass when the extract covers every flexible premium deposit received.

sop: Run both tests for each contract using the applicable definition of life insurance.
Compare the deposit to the remaining limit headroom.
Flag any deposit that breaches the applicable limit.
Done when both tests are run and breaches are flagged.
verify: Recompute headroom for a sample contract.
Pass when the recomputed headroom matches the test output.

steps.title: Run the seven-pay and modified endowment contract test
sop: Run the seven-pay test for each affected contract.
Flag any deposit that would cause modified endowment status.
Record the projected status change on the flag.
Done when the seven-pay test is run and status changes are flagged.
verify: Trace a flagged contract through the seven-pay calculation.
Pass when the flag reproduces from the contract premium history.

steps.title: Test qualified contracts against the tax-year contribution limit in Microsoft Excel
sop: Apply the current tax-year contribution limit for the plan type.
Include catch-up eligibility based on owner age.
Flag deposits above the applicable limit.
Done when qualified deposits are tested against the correct limit.
verify: Recompute the applicable limit for a sample owner.
Pass when the applied limit matches the plan type and catch-up eligibility.

steps.title: Quarantine failing deposits and notify the owner
sop: Hold each failing deposit unapplied in the policy system.
Notify the owner of the breach and the options to reduce or return.
Record the notification and the owner response date.
Done when every failing deposit is quarantined with a notification logged.
verify: List applied deposits that carry a failed test result.
Pass when no failed deposit was applied without a documented resolution.

steps.title: Retain the limit test output with the contract transaction
sop: Attach the test output including the tax-year parameters to the transaction.
Confirm the output is retrievable by contract and deposit date.
Confirm retention matches the tax evidence retention class.
Done when the test output is attached and retrievable.
verify: Retrieve the output for a sampled deposit.
Pass when the retrieved output shows the parameters used for that deposit.

generic.Defined scope/population: IRA and qualified annuity payments requiring contribution type and tax-year verification.

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Coded contribution count equals the count of qualified payments received for the period.

generic.Evidence location: The contract transaction record in the policy system and the limit workbook in Microsoft Excel.

steps.title: Confirm the contribution type code against the remittance instruction
sop: Read the remittance instruction and identify the intended money type.
Set the code as regular, rollover, transfer, conversion or catch-up.
Query the producer where the instruction is ambiguous.
Done when the coded type matches the remittance instruction.

Pass when the code matches the documented instruction.

steps.title: Confirm the tax year applied for prior-year contributions
sop: Identify contributions designated for the prior tax year.
Confirm receipt before the filing deadline for that year.
Code the tax year accordingly rather than defaulting to the current year.
Done when each contribution carries the correct tax year.
verify: Sample prior-year designations against receipt dates.
Pass when every prior-year designation was received before the filing deadline.

steps.title: Test year-to-date contributions against the annual limit in Microsoft Excel
sop: Total the owner year-to-date contributions for the tax year.
Apply the annual limit including catch-up where age eligible.
Flag any owner over the applicable limit.
Done when the limit test is run for every contributing owner.
verify: Recompute the year-to-date total for a sampled owner.
Pass when the recomputed total matches the tested figure.

steps.title: Confirm a valid TIN is on the contract in the policy administration system
sop: Check the owner TIN present and structurally valid on the contract.
Request a corrected TIN where missing or invalid.
Flag the contract for backup withholding risk until corrected.
Done when the TIN is valid or the contract is flagged.
verify: Filter contributing contracts for missing or invalid TINs.
Pass when every such contract is flagged for follow-up.

steps.title: Confirm rollovers and transfers are excluded from the limit test
sop: Filter the tested population for rollover and transfer codes.
Confirm those amounts are excluded from the annual limit calculation.
Correct the test where an exclusion was missed.
Done when rollovers and transfers are excluded from the limit test.
verify: Re-run the limit test after exclusions are corrected.
Pass when no rollover or transfer counts against the annual limit.

steps.title: Flag excess contributions and notify tax reporting the same day
sop: Flag each excess contribution for corrective distribution.
Notify the owner and the tax reporting team the same day.
Record the notification and the expected corrective action date.
Done when every excess contribution is flagged and notified.
verify: Compare flagged excess contributions to notifications sent.
Pass when every excess contribution has a same-day notification logged.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open premium suspense items on the suspense register at the aging run date.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Original receipt date, amount, source, last research action and aging bucket are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Aged register total equals the suspense general ledger balance for the same date.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Aged register version and the GL balance extract are retained with the run date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items over the thirty-day hold limit are listed with an owner and next action.
generic.Test population: All open suspense items included in the aging run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero items showing a receipt date later than the original capture date.
generic.Exception handling path: A reset receipt date is corrected by the Cash Application Specialist before publication.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Aged register totals equal the suspense GL balance for the same date.
generic.Evidence location: The aged register workbook in Microsoft Excel and the BillingCenter suspense subledger.

steps.title: Extract open suspense items from Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Extract all open suspense items with original receipt date, amount and source.
Include the last research action and research owner.
Save the extract with the aging run date.
Done when the open suspense extract for the run date is produced.
verify: Compare the extract item count to the suspense subledger open count.
Pass when the extract count equals the subledger open item count.

steps.title: Age each item into buckets in Microsoft Excel
sop: Compute days open from the original receipt date to the run date.
Assign each item to the zero to seven, eight to thirty, thirty-one to sixty or sixty plus bucket.
Total items and dollars per bucket.
Done when every item carries a bucket and the bucket totals are computed.
verify: Sum the bucket totals and compare to the extract total.
Pass when bucket totals sum exactly to the extract total.

steps.title: Isolate items over the thirty-day hold limit
sop: Filter items aged beyond the thirty-day hold limit.
List each with amount, source and last research action.
Assign a research owner to each listed item.
Done when every over-limit item is listed with an owner.
verify: Filter the over-limit list for blank owners.
Pass when no over-limit item lacks a named owner.

steps.title: Check no receipt date was reset by a re-keying transaction
sop: Compare current receipt dates to the original capture dates in the audit trail.
Flag items where the date moved forward.
Restore the original receipt date on flagged items.
Done when every item shows its original capture date.
verify: Re-run the date comparison after corrections.
Pass when no item shows a receipt date later than its original capture date.

steps.title: Reconcile the aged register total to the suspense general ledger balance
sop: Read the suspense GL balance for the run date.
Compare it to the aged register total.
Explain and document any difference before publication.
Done when the register ties to the GL or the difference is documented.
verify: Recompute the register to GL difference.
Pass when the difference is zero or fully itemised.

steps.title: Publish the aged register to the cash application team
sop: Publish the aged register with owners assigned to over-limit items.
Record the publication date and register version.
File the register with the GL extract for the run date.
Done when the register is published and filed.
verify: Retrieve the filed register for the run date.
Pass when the filed register shows bucket totals, owners and the GL reconciliation.

generic.Defined scope/population: Suspense items with a corroborated match ready for application to a policy.

Return the item to research where evidence is absent.

Return the item to research where the policy cannot accept payment.

verify: Re-read the policy status immediately before release.
Pass when the policy remains eligible at the point of release.

steps.title: Post the funds using the original receipt date in BillingCenter

Set the posting date to the original suspense receipt date.
Confirm premium-paid-to-date and grace period recalculate from that date.
Done when the posting carries the original receipt date.
verify: Read the posting date on the policy premium transaction.
Pass when the posting date equals the original suspense receipt date.

Done when the applied amount matches or the partial release is explained.
verify: List releases where applied differs from item amount.
Pass when every difference carries a recorded explanation.

Read the policy balance before and after the posting.
Confirm both moved by the applied amount.

verify: Recompute both balance movements.
Pass when the suspense decrease equals the policy balance decrease.

sop: Check the GL entries generated by the release.
Confirm suspense is relieved and premium receivable or income posted.
Investigate any missing or one-sided entry.
Done when the GL shows both sides of the release.
verify: Compare the GL suspense relief to the applied amount.
Pass when the GL relief equals the applied amount with a matching premium posting.

generic.Defined scope/population: Resolved suspense items whose documentation must be archived under the retention schedule.
generic.In-scope period: Items resolved during the current archiving cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Item ID, receipt date, amount, resolved policy number and retention class are populated on the index.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived document set count equals the count of resolved suspense items for the cycle.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each archived set carries an archive date and the document version indexed.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items with missing documents are logged and the gap chased before archiving closes.
generic.Test population: All resolved suspense items archived in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero archived sets scheduled for destruction while a legal hold is active.
generic.Exception handling path: A missing document blocks archive closure until it is sourced or a gap note is filed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Archived set is indexed by item ID, amount and resolved policy with a retention class applied.
generic.Evidence location: The document management repository archive index and the BillingCenter suspense item reference.

steps.title: Assemble the document set for each resolved item from BillingCenter
sop: Collect the remittance advice, instrument image, research notes and resolution approval.
Group them as one document set per suspense item.
Flag any item missing a required document.
Done when each resolved item has a complete document set or a logged gap.
verify: Check each set against the required document list.
Pass when every set is complete or its gap is logged.

steps.title: Index the set in the document management repository
sop: Index each set by suspense item ID, receipt date, amount and resolved policy number.
Confirm the index values match the BillingCenter item record.
Save the index entry with the archive date.
Done when every set carries a complete index entry.
verify: Compare index values to the source suspense item.
Pass when index values match the suspense record field for field.

steps.title: Apply the financial-records retention class in the document repository
sop: Select the retention class for premium receipt records.
Apply it to each archived set.
Record the computed destruction eligibility date.
Done when every set carries the correct retention class.
verify: Sample sets and read the applied retention class.
Pass when every sampled set carries the financial-records retention class.

steps.title: Test retrieval by policy number within the retrieval SLA
sop: Select a sample of archived sets.
Retrieve each by resolved policy number and time the retrieval.
Log any retrieval that misses the SLA.
Done when sampled sets retrieve inside the retrieval SLA.
verify: Read the retrieval timings logged for the sample.
Pass when every sampled retrieval completed inside the SLA.

steps.title: Check legal holds against archived sets in the document repository
sop: Extract policies under legal hold.
Match them against archived suspense sets.
Suspend destruction on every matched set.
Done when every held policy set has destruction suspended.
verify: Re-run the hold match after suspension.
Pass when no set under legal hold is scheduled for destruction.

steps.title: Reconcile archived set count to resolved suspense items for the cycle
sop: Count resolved suspense items for the cycle in BillingCenter.
Count archived document sets in the repository for the same cycle.
Chase any resolved item with no archived set.
Done when the two counts agree or every gap is chased.
verify: Recount both populations after chasing.
Pass when archived set count equals resolved item count.

generic.Defined scope/population: Suspense records whose funds have been fully dispositioned and are ready for closure.
generic.In-scope period: Items resolved during the current suspense closure cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Resolution code, zero balance, offsetting ledger reference and approval are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Closed item count plus remaining open items equals the opening suspense population.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Closure record with resolution code and approver name is retained with the closure date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items with a residual balance are logged and held open with the residual reason.
generic.Test population: All suspense records closed in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero suspense records closed with a non-zero balance.
generic.Exception handling path: A closure attempted with a residual is rejected and the item returned to research.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Closed records carry a resolution code, zero balance and a link to the offsetting ledger entry.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter suspense closure record and the offsetting entry in the ERP general ledger.

steps.title: Confirm the suspense item balance is zero in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Open the item and read the remaining balance.
Confirm every release, refund or transfer has posted.
Return items with a residual to research.
Done when the item balance reads zero.
verify: Re-read the balance immediately before closure.
Pass when the balance is zero at the point of closure.

steps.title: Record the resolution code on the closure in BillingCenter
sop: Select applied to policy, refunded to remitter, escheated or returned to agent.
Record supporting references for the chosen code.
Reject closure where no code applies.
Done when the closure carries a resolution code with references.
verify: Filter closed items for missing resolution codes.
Pass when no closed item lacks a resolution code.

steps.title: Confirm the offsetting ledger entry exists in the ERP general ledger
sop: Locate the offsetting entry that relieved the suspense balance.
Confirm it references the original suspense transaction ID.
Record the ledger reference on the closure.
Done when the closure links to the offsetting ledger entry.
verify: Open the ledger entry from the closure reference.
Pass when the entry references the original suspense transaction ID.

steps.title: Obtain second-person sign-off for items over the approval threshold
sop: Identify closures above the approval threshold.
Review the resolution and supporting evidence.
Record the approval with name and date on the closure.
Done when every above-threshold closure carries a second approval.
verify: Filter above-threshold closures for missing approvals.
Pass when every above-threshold closure has a named second approver.

steps.title: Set the suspense record to closed in BillingCenter
sop: Set the record status to closed with the closure date.
Confirm the status change writes an audit entry.
Confirm the record becomes read-only after closure.
Done when the record is closed and audited.
verify: Read the closure audit entry.
Pass when the audit shows the closure user, date and resolution code.

steps.title: Verify closed items drop off the open aging register on the next run
sop: Run the suspense aging register after closure.
Confirm the closed items no longer appear as open.
Investigate any closed item still listed.
Done when closed items are absent from the open register.
verify: Search the register for the closed item IDs.
Pass when no closed item appears on the open aging register.

generic.Defined scope/population: Unidentifiable suspense items requiring outreach to the agent, agency or applicant.
generic.In-scope period: Items inside the thirty-day hold limit awaiting identification.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Contact date, channel, person contacted, outcome and follow-up date are populated on the item.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of items with logged outreach equals the count of unidentifiable items inside the limit.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Contact log entries carry date, channel and outcome against the suspense item.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items with two unanswered attempts are logged and escalated with the escalation date.
generic.Test population: All unidentifiable suspense items open during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero unidentifiable items reaching the thirty-day limit with no logged outreach.
generic.Exception handling path: Unanswered outreach escalates to the agency principal or the supervisory review queue.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Item shows dated contact attempts with channel, contact name and outcome.
generic.Evidence location: The CRM activity log, the agency producer management system contact record and the BillingCenter item.

steps.title: Identify the likely source from the remittance instrument in BillingCenter
sop: Review the instrument image, memo line and any accompanying paperwork.
Decide whether the source is the writing agent, agency, applicant or employer.
Record the identified source on the suspense item.
Done when a likely source is recorded for the item.
verify: Compare the recorded source to the instrument evidence.
Pass when the recorded source is supported by the instrument.

steps.title: Look up the contact of record in the agency producer management system
sop: Search the producer system for the agent or agency contact of record.
Confirm the contact is active and appointed.
Return the verified contact details to the cash application specialist.
Done when a verified contact of record is available.
verify: Compare the contact used to the producer system record.
Pass when the contact used is the appointed contact of record.

steps.title: Contact the agent or agency and request the intended policy and amount
sop: Contact the agent through the verified channel of record.
Ask for the intended policy or application number and intended premium amount.
Do not disclose payor details before identity is verified.
Done when the request is made and the response is captured.
verify: Read the captured response against the suspense item amount.
Pass when the response identifies a policy and an amount to test the match.

steps.title: Verify responder identity before disclosing suspense detail
sop: Verify the responder against the producer or customer record before disclosure.
Withhold amount and payor details until verification succeeds.
Record the verification method on the item.
Done when identity verification is recorded before any disclosure.
verify: Review contact log entries where detail was disclosed.
Pass when every disclosure was preceded by a recorded verification.

steps.title: Log every attempt in the CRM against the suspense item
sop: Log date, channel, person contacted and outcome for each attempt.
Link the CRM activity to the BillingCenter suspense item.
Keep the log current after every attempt.
Done when every attempt is logged with all four attributes.
verify: Filter suspense items for outreach entries missing an attribute.
Pass when no logged attempt is missing date, channel, contact or outcome.

steps.title: Set the follow-up date inside the hold limit and escalate after two attempts
sop: Set the next follow-up date inside the thirty-day hold limit.
Escalate to supervisory review after two unanswered attempts.
Record the escalation reference on the item.
Done when a follow-up date is set or an escalation is recorded.
verify: List items at the hold limit with no outreach or escalation.
Pass when the list is empty.

generic.Defined scope/population: Suspense items aged past the thirty-day hold limit requiring supervisory review.
generic.In-scope period: The escalation cycle covering items over the hold limit at the review date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Amount, source, research trail, proposed disposition, reviewer and decision date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Escalated item count equals the count of items over the hold limit on the aged register.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Escalation pack and the recorded supervisory decision are retained with the review date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items with insufficient research are returned to the analyst and logged as not ready.
generic.Test population: All suspense items past the hold limit in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero items past the hold limit without a supervisory decision.
generic.Exception handling path: An item lacking minimum research is returned for completion before re-escalation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each over-limit item has a logged escalation with reviewer name and recorded disposition.
generic.Evidence location: The escalation case in the workflow case management tool and the BillingCenter suspense item.

steps.title: Select items past the hold limit from the BI reporting platform aged register
sop: Run the aged suspense register for the review date.
Select every item past the thirty-day hold limit.
Record the selected count and value as the escalation control.
Done when the over-limit population is selected with control totals.
verify: Recount over-limit items from the aged register.
Pass when the selected count equals the register over-limit count.

steps.title: Confirm minimum research and outreach were completed on each item
sop: Check each item for the required research steps and outreach attempts.
Return items with insufficient evidence to the analyst.
Record the return and the completion date expected.
Done when every escalated item meets the minimum research standard.
verify: Sample escalated items and read their research trails.
Pass when every sampled item shows the minimum research and outreach.

steps.title: Prepare the escalation pack in the workflow case management tool
sop: Build a case per item with amount, source, research trail and proposed disposition.
Attach the instrument image and the outreach log.
Submit the pack for supervisory review.
Done when every over-limit item has a submitted escalation case.
verify: Compare submitted case count to the over-limit population.
Pass when every over-limit item has a submitted case.

steps.title: Route each case to the supervisor with authority for the dollar band
sop: Read the resolution-authority matrix for the item amount.
Route the case to the supervisor holding that authority.
Record the routing decision on the case.
Done when every case is routed to the correct authority level.
verify: Compare case routing to the authority matrix band.
Pass when every case sits with the supervisor holding the required authority.

steps.title: Record the supervisory decision with reviewer name and date
sop: Decide continue research, refund to remitter, escheat referral or write-off.
Record the decision with reviewer name and date on the case.
State the rationale where the decision is write-off.
Done when every case carries a dated decision and reviewer name.
verify: Filter cases for missing decisions or reviewer names.
Pass when no escalated case lacks a dated decision and named reviewer.

steps.title: Write the decision and next action date back onto the suspense item
sop: Copy the decision and next action date onto the BillingCenter item.
Reassign the item to the owner responsible for the next action.
Confirm the item leaves the un-actioned queue.
Done when the item carries the decision and a next action date.
verify: Re-run the un-actioned over-limit queue.
Pass when no item past the hold limit remains without a decision.

generic.Defined scope/population: Cash-with-application and unallocated receipts requiring a same-day suspense entry.
generic.In-scope period: Receipts received on the current business day.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Remitter name, instrument type, instrument number, amount and receipt date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Suspense postings plus applied receipts equal the day total banked.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Instrument image and the suspense posting are retained with the receipt date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Receipts that cannot be posted same day are logged with the reason and next-day action.
generic.Test population: All unidentified receipts received during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero received funds sitting outside the suspense subledger at end of day.
generic.Exception handling path: A receipt held in a desk queue is escalated and posted before day close.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every unidentified receipt has a same-day suspense entry with remitter, instrument and date.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter suspense subledger and the ERP general ledger suspense account.

steps.title: Identify cash-with-application and unidentified receipts for the day
sop: Review the day receipt population for items with no confident policy match.
Separate cash-with-application receipts from unidentified remittances.
List both groups for suspense posting.
Done when both groups are identified for the day.
verify: Compare the listed groups to the day capture register.
Pass when every unmatched receipt appears in one of the two groups.

steps.title: Post each receipt to premium suspense in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Create a suspense entry for each listed receipt on the day of receipt.
Use the bank date as the receipt date on the entry.
Never hold a receipt unposted overnight.
Done when every listed receipt has a same-day suspense entry.
verify: Compare suspense entry count to the listed receipt count.
Pass when the counts agree for the business date.

steps.title: Capture remitter, instrument and amount details on the entry
sop: Record remitter name, instrument type, instrument number and amount.
Attach the instrument image to the entry.
Correct any entry with a blank required field.
Done when every entry carries the required attributes and an image.
verify: Filter entries for blank remitter, instrument or amount.
Pass when the filter returns no entries.

steps.title: Reconcile suspense postings plus applied receipts to the day banked total
sop: Total suspense postings and applied receipts for the day.
Compare the sum to the total banked for the same date.
Investigate any difference before day close.
Done when the sum equals the day banked total or the difference is explained.
verify: Recompute the day totals from the register and bank advice.
Pass when suspense plus applied equals the banked total.

steps.title: Sweep physical and desktop queues before day close
sop: Check physical mail trays and desktop work queues for unposted receipts.
Post any found receipt to suspense the same day.
Record the sweep as completed on the day checklist.
Done when the sweep is complete and no receipt remains unposted.
verify: Repeat the sweep at day close.
Pass when no received funds remain outside the suspense subledger.

steps.title: Confirm suspense postings hit the mapped ERP general ledger account
sop: Check the GL account used by the day suspense postings.
Confirm postings hit the suspense account and not premium income.
Raise a correcting entry for any misposting.
Done when all suspense postings sit in the mapped GL suspense account.
verify: Read the GL suspense movement for the day.
Pass when the GL movement equals the day suspense postings.
