generic.Defined scope/population: Open suspense items being researched against pending applications and in-force policies.
generic.In-scope period: Items under research during the current matching cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Candidate policy, corroborating fields, match rationale and researcher are populated on the item.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Matched item count plus unmatched item count equals the open research population.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Instrument image, memo line evidence and remittance advice are retained against the item.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items with only a single-field match are logged as unmatched and returned to research.
generic.Test population: All suspense items researched during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero items marked matched on a single-field name match alone.
generic.Exception handling path: A weak candidate match is rejected and the item continues research or escalates.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Matched items record the corroborating fields used to reach the match.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter suspense item research notes and the policy system application and policy records.

steps.title: Search pending applications and in-force policies in the policy system
sop: Search on remitter name, amount, agent code and date range.
Build a candidate list rather than accepting the first hit.
Record the candidates on the suspense item.
Done when a candidate list is recorded for the item.
verify: Re-run the search with the same parameters.
Pass when the recorded candidate list reproduces from the search.

steps.title: Corroborate the candidate on at least two independent attributes
sop: Test exact amount, policy or application number, payor name and writing agent.
Require at least two attributes to agree before accepting the candidate.
Reject candidates supported by name alone.
Done when the accepted candidate has two corroborating attributes.
verify: Read the corroborating attributes recorded on the item.
Pass when at least two attributes support every accepted match.

steps.title: Check the instrument memo line and remittance advice image
sop: Open the instrument image and read the memo line text.
Open any accompanying remittance advice image.
Record any policy or application reference found.
Done when the memo line and advice have been reviewed and recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded memo evidence to the image.
Pass when the recorded evidence matches the instrument image.

steps.title: Confirm the candidate policy has a consistent outstanding balance
sop: Open the candidate account in BillingCenter and read the outstanding balance.
Compare it to the suspense item amount.
Reject candidates whose balance is inconsistent with the amount.
Done when the candidate balance is consistent with the item amount.
verify: Recheck the candidate balance at the point of match acceptance.
Pass when the balance remains consistent with the suspense amount.

steps.title: Record the match rationale on the suspense item in BillingCenter
sop: Write the rationale naming the corroborating fields used.
Attach the supporting evidence references.
Mark the item matched and ready for application.
Done when the rationale and evidence are recorded on the item.
verify: Read the rationale on a sample of matched items.
Pass when every sampled rationale names its corroborating fields.

steps.title: Return unmatched items to research with the clues gathered
sop: Return items without two corroborating attributes to the research queue.
Record the clues already tested so work is not repeated.
Set the next research date inside the hold limit.
Done when unmatched items carry recorded clues and a next research date.
verify: Filter unmatched items for missing next research dates.
Pass when every unmatched item has a next research date inside the hold limit.

generic.Defined scope/population: The premium suspense subledger open items and the suspense general ledger account balance.
generic.In-scope period: The business date being reconciled at the daily close.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Subledger total, GL balance, difference explanations and reviewer sign-off are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Subledger open item total equals the suspense GL balance for the same date.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reconciliation with both extracts and sign-off is retained with the business date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items beyond the aging threshold without escalation are logged and referred the same day.
generic.Test population: All open suspense items and GL suspense postings for the reconciled date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero unexplained difference between the suspense subledger and the GL balance.
generic.Exception handling path: An unexplained difference holds the close until the Accountant identifies the cause.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reconciliation shows subledger to GL agreement with itemised differences and reviewer sign-off.
generic.Evidence location: The reconciliation workbook in Microsoft Excel with the ERP GL and BillingCenter subledger extracts.

steps.title: Extract the suspense subledger open items from Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Extract open suspense items as at the reconciliation date.
Total the open item value and count.
Save the extract for comparison.
Done when the subledger extract and totals are produced.
verify: Recount and re-total the extract.
Pass when the extract totals reproduce on recount.

steps.title: Read the suspense GL account balance from the ERP general ledger
sop: Read the suspense account balance for the same business date.
Confirm no postings after the cut-off are included.
Record the balance for comparison.
Done when the GL balance for the date is recorded.
verify: Re-read the GL balance after the day cut-off.
Pass when the recorded balance equals the post-cut-off GL balance.

steps.title: Compare subledger total to GL balance in Microsoft Excel
sop: Compute the difference between the subledger total and the GL balance.
List every reconciling item including in-transit postings and same-day reversals.
Explain each item on the reconciliation.
Done when the difference is fully itemised and explained.
verify: Sum the reconciling items and compare to the difference.
Pass when the reconciling items account for the entire difference.

steps.title: Confirm the open item count agrees to the aged register
sop: Compare the open item count to the aged register used for follow-up.
Investigate any count difference.
Correct the register or the extract as required.
Done when both counts agree.
verify: Recount both populations after correction.
Pass when the subledger and aged register counts agree.

steps.title: Confirm items beyond the aging threshold carry an escalation reference
sop: Filter open items beyond the aging threshold.
Check each for an escalation reference.
Refer any unescalated item the same day.
Done when every over-threshold item carries an escalation reference.
verify: Re-run the over-threshold filter after referral.
Pass when no over-threshold item lacks an escalation reference.

steps.title: Obtain reviewer sign-off and file the reconciliation as evidence
sop: Review the reconciliation and its supporting extracts.
Confirm the preparer is not the reviewer.
Sign, date and file the reconciliation.
Done when the reconciliation is signed and filed for the date.
verify: Retrieve the filed reconciliation for the business date.
Pass when the filed copy shows preparer and reviewer sign-off.

generic.Defined scope/population: Receipts requiring a new suspense item record with source and identifying information.
generic.In-scope period: Receipts recorded to suspense during the current business day.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Source, remitter, amount, receipt date, instrument reference and research owner are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Created suspense item value equals the value of receipts routed to suspense for the day.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Scanned instrument and accompanying paperwork are attached at creation with a timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items created with incomplete clues are logged for enrichment before the first follow-up.
generic.Test population: All suspense items created during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero suspense items with a blank remitter and a blank amount.
generic.Exception handling path: An unreadable instrument is re-imaged before the item is released to research.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Item has source, remitter, amount, receipt date, attached image and a research owner.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter suspense item record and the attached image in the document management repository.

steps.title: Create the suspense item in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Create the item capturing source, remitter name, amount and receipt date.
Record the instrument reference from the cheque or draft.
Save the item and note the item ID.
Done when the item exists with the core attributes captured.
verify: Re-open the item and read the captured attributes.
Pass when source, remitter, amount and receipt date are all populated.

steps.title: Attach the scanned instrument and paperwork from the document repository
sop: Scan or retrieve the instrument image and any application or advice.
Attach the images to the suspense item at creation.
Re-image any unreadable document before attaching.
Done when legible images are attached to the item.
verify: Open each attachment from the item.
Pass when every attachment opens and is legible.

steps.title: Record identifying clues in structured fields on the item
sop: Record agent code, application number and memo line text in structured fields.
Avoid burying clues in free-text notes only.
Confirm the fields are searchable for later matching.
Done when available clues are stored in structured fields.
verify: Search on a recorded clue and confirm the item returns.
Pass when the item is retrievable by its recorded clues.

steps.title: Confirm the keyed amount equals the instrument and deposit line
sop: Compare the keyed amount to the instrument image amount.
Compare it to the deposit line amount on the bank advice.
Correct the item where the amounts differ.
Done when the keyed amount matches both sources.
verify: Re-compare the keyed amount to the instrument and deposit line.
Pass when all three amounts agree.

steps.title: Assign a research owner and set the first follow-up date
sop: Assign the item to a named research owner.
Set the first follow-up date inside the hold limit.
Notify the owner of the new assignment.
Done when the item has an owner and a first follow-up date.
verify: Filter new items for blank owner or follow-up date.
Pass when the filter returns no items.

steps.title: Reconcile created items to receipts routed to suspense for the day
sop: Total created suspense items for the day.
Compare to receipts routed to suspense in the capture register.
Create any missing item before day close.
Done when created items equal receipts routed to suspense.
verify: Recompute both day totals.
Pass when created item value equals routed receipt value.

generic.Defined scope/population: Aged unresolvable suspense items that have passed the applicable state dormancy period.
generic.In-scope period: The escheatment referral cycle covering items reaching dormancy in the period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Dormancy start date, due-diligence evidence, reportable state and referral reference are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Referred item value equals the transfer into the unclaimed property holding account.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Research trail and due-diligence letters are retained with the referral package and dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items with incomplete due diligence are logged and held back from the referral.
generic.Test population: All items referred to escheatment in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero items referred before the applicable dormancy period elapsed.
generic.Exception handling path: An early referral is recalled and the item returned to suspense until dormancy is reached.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Referral records the dormancy start date, due-diligence evidence and the reportable state.
generic.Evidence location: The ERP unclaimed property holding account and the referral package in the document repository.

steps.title: Confirm the dormancy period has elapsed from the original receipt date
sop: Read the original receipt date on each candidate item.
Apply the state dormancy period for premium funds.
Exclude items with owner contact inside the period.
Done when every candidate has passed its dormancy period.
verify: Recompute dormancy elapsed for a sample of candidates.
Pass when no candidate is inside its dormancy period.

steps.title: Confirm owner due-diligence outreach was performed and evidenced
sop: Check each item for the required due-diligence outreach.
Confirm the outreach letter and its send date are retained.
Hold back items with missing evidence.
Done when every referred item carries due-diligence evidence.
verify: Retrieve the due-diligence letter for a sample of items.
Pass when every sampled item has a retained dated outreach letter.

steps.title: Determine the reportable state from the last known owner address
sop: Read the last known owner address on the item or the source policy.
Assign the reportable state from that address.
Default to the state of incorporation where no address exists.
Done when every item carries a reportable state and the basis used.
verify: Sample items and compare the assigned state to the address evidence.
Pass when every assignment follows the address or the documented default.

steps.title: Transfer the item to the unclaimed property holding account in the ERP
sop: Post the transfer from premium suspense to the unclaimed property account.
Confirm the transfer amount equals the item balance.
Record the transfer reference on the suspense item.
Done when the funds sit in the unclaimed property holding account.
verify: Compare the transfer total to the referred item total.
Pass when the transfer equals the referred item value.

steps.title: Record the escheat referral reference on the suspense item in BillingCenter
sop: Write the escheat referral reference onto the suspense item.
Set the resolution code to escheated.
Confirm the item is removed from the active research queue.
Done when the item shows the referral reference and resolution code.
verify: Search the research queue for referred items.
Pass when no referred item remains in the active research queue.

steps.title: Retain the research and due-diligence trail with the referral package
sop: Assemble the research trail, due-diligence letters and transfer evidence.
File the package in the document repository under the statutory retention class.
Index it by reportable state and referral period.
Done when the referral package is filed with the statutory retention class.
verify: Retrieve the package by reportable state and period.
Pass when the retrieved package contains research, due diligence and transfer evidence.

generic.Defined scope/population: Cash-with-application funds held in suspense for applications that were declined or withdrawn.
generic.In-scope period: Declines and withdrawals recorded in the current refund processing cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Decline record, refund amount, payee of record, screening result and disbursement reference are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Refund amount equals the original cash-with-application receipt less any permitted filed fee.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Decline evidence, screening result and disbursement advice are retained with the refund date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requests to pay a different payee are logged with the written instruction obtained.
generic.Test population: All cash-with-application refunds issued in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero refunds issued before the application decline was recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: A sanctions hit blocks disbursement until compliance adjudicates the match.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Refund references the declined application and the original remitter with a screening result.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter suspense item, the ERP disbursement record and the decline evidence in the repository.

steps.title: Confirm the application is declined or withdrawn in the policy system
sop: Open the application and read its status and decision date.
Confirm the decline or withdrawal is formally recorded.
Attach the decision evidence to the refund case.
Done when the decline or withdrawal is confirmed and evidenced.
verify: Re-read the application status before disbursement.
Pass when the application remains declined or withdrawn at disbursement.

steps.title: Compute the refund amount from the suspense item in BillingCenter
sop: Read the original cash-with-application receipt amount.
Deduct only fees permitted by the filed schedule.
Record the refund amount and any deduction basis.
Done when the refund amount is computed with its deduction basis.
verify: Recompute the refund from the receipt less permitted fees.
Pass when the computed refund equals the recorded refund amount.

steps.title: Identify the original remitter of record as payee
sop: Read the remitter from the original instrument and suspense record.
Direct the refund to that remitter by default.
Obtain and file written instruction for any different payee.
Done when the payee is the remitter of record or a documented alternative.
verify: Compare the payee to the original instrument remitter.
Pass when the payee matches the remitter or has a filed written instruction.

steps.title: Screen the payee against sanctions lists before disbursement
sop: Submit the payee name and bank details for sanctions screening.
Hold disbursement on any potential match pending adjudication.
Record the screening reference on the refund case.
Done when a screening result is recorded against the case.
verify: Read the screening result on the case.
Pass when a clear screening result predates the disbursement.

steps.title: Issue the refund through the ERP general ledger within the state timeframe
sop: Raise the disbursement for the computed refund amount.
Confirm issuance falls inside the state-mandated timeframe from the decline date.
Capture the payment reference on the refund case.
Done when the refund is issued inside the mandated timeframe.
verify: Compare the issue date to the decline date and the state limit.
Pass when the elapsed days are inside the state-mandated timeframe.

steps.title: Record the disbursement reference on the suspense item and close it
sop: Write the disbursement reference onto the suspense item.
Set the resolution code to refunded to remitter.
Confirm the suspense balance reduces to zero.
Done when the item is closed with the disbursement reference.
verify: Read the suspense item balance and resolution code.
Pass when the balance is zero and the disbursement reference is present.

generic.Defined scope/population: Open premium suspense items as at month end reported by aging bucket.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting month from the prior month end to the current month end.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Bucket counts, bucket values, movement categories and commentary fields are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Report total reconciles to the suspense general ledger balance at month end.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report version and its warehouse extract are retained with the month end date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Largest aged items and over-limit counts are called out with the action in flight.
generic.Test population: All open suspense items at month end plus movements during the month.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero unreconciled difference between the report total and the suspense GL balance.
generic.Exception handling path: An unreconciled difference holds distribution until the Accountant explains it.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Monthly report reconciles to the suspense GL balance and shows prior-month movement.
generic.Evidence location: The BI reporting platform monthly report and the warehouse suspense extract.

steps.title: Extract month-end open suspense to the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Extract open suspense items as at month end with receipt dates and amounts.
Load the extract into the warehouse table feeding the report.
Confirm the extract date equals the accounting month end.
Done when the month-end extract is loaded.
verify: Compare loaded totals to the BillingCenter subledger at month end.
Pass when loaded totals equal the subledger month-end totals.

steps.title: Build the aging bucket summary in the BI reporting platform
sop: Summarise open items by aging bucket with counts and dollar values.
Confirm the buckets match the standard aging definitions.
Check the bucket totals sum to the open population.
Done when the bucket summary is built and sums correctly.
verify: Sum the bucket values and compare to the extract total.
Pass when the bucket totals sum exactly to the extract total.

steps.title: Reconcile the report total to the suspense GL balance
sop: Read the suspense GL balance at month end.
Compare it to the report total and list reconciling items.
Hold distribution where a difference is unexplained.
Done when the report reconciles to the GL or differences are itemised.
verify: Recompute the report to GL difference.
Pass when the difference is zero or fully itemised.

steps.title: Show prior-month movement categories in the report
sop: Compute new items, resolved items, escalated items and escheat referrals.
Show the movement bridging prior month end to current month end.
Confirm the bridge reconciles both balances.
Done when the movement bridge is complete and reconciles.
verify: Apply the movement to the prior month balance.
Pass when the bridged result equals the current month balance.

steps.title: Call out the largest aged items and over-limit counts
sop: List the largest individual aged items with amounts and owners.
Show the count of items over the thirty-day hold limit.
Note the action in flight for each highlighted item.
Done when the highlights and their actions are on the report.
verify: Compare highlighted items to the aged register.
Pass when every highlighted item reconciles to the aged register.

steps.title: Distribute the report to finance and compliance by the close working day
sop: Write commentary on any adverse trend in aging or volume.
Publish the report to finance and compliance.
Record the publication date and version.
Done when the report is published by the agreed close working day.
verify: Read the publication log entry.
Pass when publication occurred on or before the agreed close working day.

generic.Defined scope/population: Suspense items confirmed unmatchable where funds must be returned to the remitter.
generic.In-scope period: Items approved for return during the current disposition cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Remitter name and address, supervisory approval, screening result and letter reference are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Returned amount equals the suspense item balance being cleared.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Research trail, approval, screening result and explanation letter are retained with the return date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requests to pay a party other than the remitter are logged with the written instruction filed.
generic.Test population: All funds returned to remitters in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero returns to a party other than the remitter of record without filed written instruction.
generic.Exception handling path: A sanctions match blocks the return and routes the item to blocked-property handling.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Return shows supervisory approval, a screening result and an explanation letter reference.
generic.Evidence location: The ERP disbursement record, the letter in the document repository and the BillingCenter item.

steps.title: Confirm the research trail shows the item cannot be matched
sop: Review the full research trail and outreach log on the item.
Confirm all reasonable matching avenues are exhausted.
Summarise the research conclusion on the item.
Done when the unmatchable conclusion is documented.
verify: Read the research summary and outreach log.
Pass when the trail shows exhausted matching avenues before return.

steps.title: Obtain supervisory approval to return the funds
sop: Review the research conclusion and the amount to be returned.
Approve the return at the authority level for the amount.
Record the approval name and date on the item.
Done when a dated supervisory approval is recorded.
verify: Filter returns for missing supervisory approval.
Pass when no return proceeded without a dated approval.

steps.title: Verify remitter name and address from the original instrument
sop: Read the remitter name and address from the original instrument image.
Do not use an unverified inbound request as the address source.
Record the address source on the item.
Done when the payee address is taken from the original instrument.
verify: Compare the payee address to the instrument image.
Pass when the payee address matches the original instrument.

steps.title: Screen the remitter against sanctions lists before disbursement
sop: Submit the remitter name and bank details for sanctions screening.
Hold the return where a potential match is returned.
Record the screening reference on the item.
Done when a screening result is recorded before disbursement.
verify: Read the screening result date against the disbursement date.
Pass when screening cleared before the return was disbursed.

steps.title: Issue the return with an explanation letter from the document repository
sop: Generate the letter stating amount, original receipt date and reason for return.
Issue the disbursement and enclose or send the letter.
File the letter with a retrievable reference.
Done when the return and its explanation letter are issued.
verify: Retrieve the letter by its reference.
Pass when the letter states the amount, receipt date and reason.

steps.title: Complete the return inside the state timeframe and record references
sop: Confirm the return is completed inside the state-mandated timeframe.
Record the disbursement and letter references on the suspense item.
Set the resolution code and confirm a zero balance.
Done when the item is cleared with both references recorded.
verify: Compare the return date to the mandated timeframe.
Pass when the return completed inside the timeframe with both references on the item.

generic.Defined scope/population: Original suspense entries requiring reversal once the funds have been applied.
generic.In-scope period: Reversals posted on the same business date as the related policy application.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Original transaction ID, reversal amount, business date and accounting period are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reversal amount equals the original suspense entry amount with no residual cent.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Original entry and reversal are both retained in the audit trail with timestamps.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reversals that cannot post same day are logged with the reason and the target date.
generic.Test population: All suspense reversals posted in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero original suspense entries deleted rather than reversed.
generic.Exception handling path: A period mismatch holds the reversal until both legs can post in the same period.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reversal references the original transaction ID and relieves suspense by the exact amount.
generic.Evidence location: The BillingCenter suspense transaction history and the ERP general ledger reversal entry.

steps.title: Locate the original suspense entry in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Open the suspense item and read the original transaction ID and amount.
Confirm the related policy application has posted.
Record both references on the reversal request.
Done when the original entry and the application posting are identified.
verify: Compare the identified original entry to the item history.
Pass when the transaction ID matches the original suspense posting.

steps.title: Post the reversal referencing the original transaction ID
sop: Post the reversal for the exact original amount.
Reference the original transaction ID on the reversal.
Do not delete or edit the original entry.
Done when the reversal is posted with the original reference.
verify: Read the reversal entry reference and amount.
Pass when the reversal references the original ID for the exact amount.

steps.title: Confirm reversal and premium application share the same business date
sop: Compare the reversal date to the premium application date.
Confirm both fall in the same accounting period.
Hold the reversal where the periods differ.
Done when both legs share a business date and period.
verify: Read both posting dates and their period codes.
Pass when both legs post on the same date and period.

steps.title: Confirm the suspense GL account is relieved by the exact amount
sop: Read the suspense GL movement generated by the reversal.
Compare it to the original suspense posting.
Investigate any residual cent difference.
Done when the GL relief equals the original posting amount.
verify: Recompute the suspense account movement.
Pass when the relief equals the original amount with no residual.

steps.title: Verify the audit trail retains both the original entry and the reversal
sop: Open the transaction audit trail for the suspense item.
Confirm the original entry is still visible alongside the reversal.
Escalate any case where the original was overwritten.
Done when both entries are visible in the audit trail.
verify: Read the audit trail for the item.
Pass when the original entry and reversal both appear.

steps.title: Confirm the suspense item balance is cleared in BillingCenter
sop: Refresh the suspense item after the reversal.
Confirm the balance reads zero.
Route the item to closure processing.
Done when the item balance is zero and closure is queued.
verify: Read the item balance after the reversal.
Pass when the balance is zero with no residual cent.

generic.Defined scope/population: Life contracts reaching grace period end with no automatic premium loan capacity available.
generic.In-scope period: Contracts whose grace period expires in the current nonforfeiture processing cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Elected nonforfeiture option, loan balance, accrued interest and resulting benefit values are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Nonforfeiture values calculated equal the net cash value less loan and accrued interest.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Calculation output and the owner notice are retained with the grace period end date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Contracts with remaining loan capacity are logged and returned to the premium loan path.
generic.Test population: All contracts processed for nonforfeiture in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero nonforfeiture options applied while automatic premium loan capacity remained.
generic.Exception handling path: A contract with available loan value is rerouted to automatic premium loan before nonforfeiture.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Contract shows the option applied as of grace period end with recalculated benefit values.
generic.Evidence location: The contract record in the policy administration system and the owner notice in the repository.

steps.title: Confirm no automatic premium loan capacity exists in the policy system
sop: Compute net cash value less existing loan and accrued interest.
Compare the result to the overdue premium.
Return the contract to the loan path where capacity exists.
Done when the absence of loan capacity is confirmed and recorded.
verify: Recompute available loan value for the contract.
Pass when available loan value is less than the overdue premium.

steps.title: Read the contract nonforfeiture election of record
sop: Open the contract and read the elected nonforfeiture option.
Use reduced paid-up, extended term or cash surrender as elected.
Apply the contractual default where no election exists.
Done when the option to apply is identified and recorded.
verify: Compare the identified option to the contract election field.
Pass when the option applied matches the election or the contractual default.

steps.title: Calculate values as of the grace period end date
sop: Set the valuation date to the grace period end date.
Net off outstanding loan and accrued loan interest.
Produce the resulting benefit values for the elected option.
Done when the values are calculated as of grace period end.
verify: Recompute the values from cash value less loan and interest.
Pass when the recomputed values match the calculation output.

steps.title: Write the resulting benefit values to the contract record
sop: Write the reduced paid-up face amount or extended term period to the contract.
Set the option effective date to the grace period end date.
Confirm premium billing stops from that date.
Done when the contract shows the applied option and its values.
verify: Re-read the contract benefit values after the update.
Pass when the contract values equal the calculated values.

steps.title: Confirm the ledger reflects the nonforfeiture change in the ERP
sop: Confirm reserve and premium postings reflect the option applied.
Confirm loan balances are settled or carried per the option applied.
Investigate any posting inconsistent with the contract values.
Done when ledger postings agree with the applied option.
verify: Compare ledger postings to the contract value change.
Pass when the postings agree with the applied nonforfeiture option.

steps.title: Issue the owner notice and file it in the document repository
sop: Generate the notice stating the option applied, effective date and benefit values.
Send it to the owner delivery preference of record.
File the notice against the contract.
Done when the notice is issued and filed.
verify: Retrieve the notice from the repository by contract number.
Pass when the filed notice states the option, effective date and values.

generic.Defined scope/population: Policies with an approved disability claim entitling the owner to waiver of premium.
generic.In-scope period: Installments falling within the approved waiver period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Claim approval reference, waiver start date, credited installments and notice suppression flags are set.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Credited installments equal the installments due inside the approved waiver period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Claim decision record and the credit postings are retained with the waiver start date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Premium already collected inside the waiver period is logged and refunded or credited.
generic.Test population: All policies with a waiver credit applied in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero lapse or dunning actions remaining active on a policy with an approved waiver.
generic.Exception handling path: A dunning action started during pending claim review is halted and reversed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Waiver credits exist for each installment in the approved period with notices suppressed.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter credit transactions and the claim decision record in the policy system.

steps.title: Confirm the disability claim approval and waiver start date in the policy system
sop: Open the claim decision record and read the approval and waiver start date.
Confirm the waiver rider is present on the contract.
Record the approval reference on the billing case.
Done when the approval and waiver start date are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded start date to the claim decision record.
Pass when the recorded date matches the approved waiver start date.

steps.title: Credit waived premium to the billing account in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Identify installments falling inside the approved waiver period.
Post a waiver credit for each of those installments.
Confirm the account balance reduces by the credited total.
Done when every in-period installment carries a waiver credit.
verify: Compare credited installments to installments due in the waiver period.
Pass when the counts and values agree.

steps.title: Suppress premium notices and EFT drafts for waived installments
sop: Set notice suppression for the waived installments.
Suspend the EFT draft schedule for the waiver period.
Confirm no notice or draft is queued for those installments.
Done when notices and drafts are suppressed for the waiver period.
verify: Run the next notice and draft selections in preview.
Pass when no waived installment is selected for notice or draft.

steps.title: Refund or credit premium already collected for waived installments
sop: Identify premium already collected for installments now waived.
Raise a refund or an account credit as the owner elects.
Record the disposition on the billing case.
Done when every collected waived installment is refunded or credited.
verify: List collected premium inside the waiver period.
Pass when every such item shows a refund or credit disposition.

steps.title: Halt dunning, grace and lapse activity triggered during the claim decision
sop: List dunning, grace and lapse actions active on the policy.
Cancel each action arising from premium now waived.
Confirm the policy status returns to in force and current.
Done when no waiver-affected collection action remains active.
verify: Re-run the collection action query for the policy.
Pass when no dunning or lapse action remains active.

steps.title: Confirm the policy system reflects the waived paid-to date
sop: Confirm the premium-paid-to date advances for the waived installments.
Confirm the contract remains in force through the waiver period.
Record the confirmation on the billing case.
Done when the policy record reflects the waived period as paid.
verify: Compare the paid-to date to the end of the credited installments.
Pass when the paid-to date covers every waived installment.

generic.Defined scope/population: Cancelled policies requiring a return premium calculation for the unearned portion.
generic.In-scope period: Cancellations effective in the current return premium calculation cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Cancellation reason, method, effective date, day counts and net return amount are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Earned plus unearned premium equals total written premium for the cancelled term.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Calculation worksheet is retained with the cancellation effective date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Non-refundable taxes and fees are logged with the state rule that excludes them.
generic.Test population: All return premium calculations produced in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero short-rate calculations applied to a company-initiated cancellation.
generic.Exception handling path: An incorrect method is recalculated by the Billing Specialist before transmission to refunds.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Calculation shows the method used, the in-force day count and the earned unearned split.
generic.Evidence location: The calculation worksheet in Microsoft Excel and the BillingCenter cancellation transaction.

steps.title: Read the cancellation reason and effective date in the policy system
sop: Open the cancellation transaction and read the reason code and effective date.
Identify whether the cancellation was company or insured initiated.
Record both on the calculation case.
Done when the reason and effective date are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded reason to the policy cancellation transaction.
Pass when the recorded reason and date match the policy record.

steps.title: Select pro-rata or short-rate from the cancellation reason
sop: Apply pro-rata for company-initiated and flat cancellations.
Apply short-rate only where the insured cancels and the filing permits it.
Record the method and the rule that supports it.
Done when the method is selected with its supporting rule.
verify: Check the method against the cancellation initiator.
Pass when no company-initiated cancellation carries a short-rate method.

steps.title: Compute unearned premium on the exact day count basis in Microsoft Excel
sop: Count days in force from effective date to cancellation date.
Divide by days in term to derive the earned proportion.
Compute earned and unearned premium from written premium.
Done when the earned unearned split is computed on exact days.
verify: Recompute the day counts and the split independently.
Pass when the recomputed split matches the worksheet.

steps.title: Adjust for endorsements, prior returns and unpaid earned premium
sop: List endorsements, prior returns and unpaid earned installments.
Adjust the gross unearned figure for each item.
Show each adjustment separately on the worksheet.
Done when all adjustments are applied and shown.
verify: Recompute net return as gross unearned less listed adjustments.
Pass when the recomputed net equals the worksheet net return.

steps.title: Apply state rules on taxes, surcharges and policy fees
sop: Read the state rules on refunding premium tax, surcharges and fees.
Exclude non-refundable items from the return.
Record the rule reference for each exclusion.
Done when refundability is applied per state rule with references.
verify: Compare excluded items to the state rule references.
Pass when every exclusion is supported by a cited state rule.

steps.title: Retain the calculation worksheet against the cancellation in BillingCenter
sop: Save the worksheet showing dates, day counts, split and net return.
Attach it to the cancellation transaction.
Confirm it is retrievable by policy and cancellation date.
Done when the worksheet is attached and retrievable.
verify: Retrieve the worksheet from the cancellation transaction.
Pass when the worksheet shows method, day count and the earned unearned split.

generic.Defined scope/population: Policies unpaid at the statutory cancellation deadline and queued for lapse or cancellation.
generic.In-scope period: Policies reaching their stated cancellation effective date in the current run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Notice mail date, statutory period elapsed, effective date and non-payment reason code are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Cancelled policy count equals the queued population less policies cured before the deadline.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Statutory notice proof of mailing and the cancellation transaction are retained with dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Policies with in-flight payments or arrangements are logged and pulled from the run.
generic.Test population: All policies processed in the lapse and cancellation run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero policies cancelled where a payment posted before the notice deadline.
generic.Exception handling path: A late-discovered payment triggers reinstatement processing and reversal of the cancellation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Cancellation records the non-payment reason code and the effective date on the statutory notice.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter cancellation transaction, the policy system status and the notice proof in the repository.

steps.title: Re-check for payments and arrangements immediately before execution
sop: Re-query payments posted, drafts in flight and approved arrangements.
Pull any policy with a qualifying payment or arrangement from the run.
Record the pull reason on each removed policy.
Done when the run contains only genuinely unpaid policies.
verify: Re-run the payment query after the pulls.
Pass when no policy in the run has a qualifying payment or arrangement.

steps.title: Confirm the statutory notice was mailed and the period expired
sop: Read the proof of mailing date for the statutory notice on each policy.
Compute the statutory period from that date.
Exclude policies whose period has not expired.
Done when every remaining policy has an expired statutory period.
verify: Recompute the statutory period elapsed for a sample.
Pass when every sampled policy has an expired notice period.

steps.title: Set the cancellation effective date from the statutory notice
sop: Read the cancellation date stated on the mailed notice.
Set the transaction effective date to that date and never earlier.
Flag any mismatch for correction before execution.
Done when effective dates equal the notice dates.
verify: Compare transaction effective dates to notice dates.
Pass when every effective date equals its stated notice date.

steps.title: Execute the cancellation in the policy administration system
sop: Post the cancellation with the non-payment reason code.
Confirm the policy status updates to lapsed or cancelled non-pay.
Record the transaction reference on the billing case.
Done when the policy status reflects the cancellation.
verify: Read the policy status and reason code after execution.
Pass when the status is cancelled non-pay with the correct reason code.

steps.title: Confirm downstream effects fire in BillingCenter and the policy system
sop: Confirm billing is suppressed from the effective date.
Confirm return premium calculation is triggered.
Confirm lienholders and additional interests are notified.
Done when all three downstream effects are confirmed.
verify: Check each downstream artefact for a sampled policy.
Pass when suppression, return premium and interest notice all exist.

steps.title: File the run evidence in the document management repository
sop: Assemble the run list, pull list and notice proofs.
File the pack indexed by run date.
Record the executed and pulled counts on the pack.
Done when the run evidence pack is filed.
verify: Retrieve the pack and reconcile executed plus pulled to the queued population.
Pass when executed plus pulled equals the queued population.

generic.Defined scope/population: Billing accounts whose installment due dates have passed without a matching payment applied.
generic.In-scope period: The scan date comparing due dates to payments applied as at that business date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Days past due, outstanding amount, dunning stage and exclusion reason are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Flagged past-due balance reconciles to the aged receivable balance for the scan date.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Past-due worklist and the aged receivable extract are retained with the scan date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Accounts excluded for in-flight drafts or arrangements are logged with the exclusion reason.
generic.Test population: All billing accounts with an installment due on or before the scan date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero accounts with an in-flight draft or same-day portal payment on the worklist.
generic.Exception handling path: An account wrongly flagged is removed and the exclusion rule corrected before the next scan.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Worklist reconciles to the aged receivable balance for the scan date.
generic.Evidence location: The BI past-due worklist and the BillingCenter installment and payment records.

steps.title: Run the past-due scan in Guidewire BillingCenter for the business date
sop: Compare installment due dates to payments applied as at the scan date.
Select accounts with an unpaid installment past its due date.
Record the raw candidate count and balance.
Done when the raw past-due population is selected.
verify: Recount the raw candidates from the installment records.
Pass when the recounted population equals the scan output.

steps.title: Exclude in-flight drafts, same-day payments and approved arrangements
sop: Remove accounts with an EFT draft in flight for the unpaid installment.
Remove accounts with a portal payment posted on the scan date.
Remove accounts with an approved payment arrangement in force.
Done when all three exclusion groups are removed and logged.
verify: Re-scan the remaining worklist for exclusion conditions.
Pass when no remaining account meets an exclusion condition.

steps.title: Apply the de-minimis tolerance to immaterial shortfalls
sop: Compare each shortfall to the de-minimis tolerance.
Remove accounts inside tolerance from the non-pay workflow.
Log the tolerance exclusions for reporting.
Done when tolerance exclusions are applied and logged.
verify: Filter the worklist for balances inside tolerance.
Pass when no in-tolerance account remains on the worklist.

steps.title: Assign each flagged account to its dunning stage in BillingCenter
sop: Compute days past due for each remaining account.
Assign the dunning stage matching that age band.
Confirm no account skips a required stage.
Done when every flagged account carries a dunning stage.
verify: Compare assigned stages to days past due for a sample.
Pass when every sampled stage matches its days past due band.

steps.title: Reconcile the flagged population to the aged receivable balance
sop: Total the flagged past-due balance.
Compare it to the aged receivable balance for the scan date.
Investigate and document any difference.
Done when the worklist reconciles to the aged receivable balance.
verify: Recompute the reconciliation from both sources.
Pass when the difference is zero or fully explained.

steps.title: Publish the past-due worklist from the BI reporting platform
sop: Publish the worklist with balances, ages and dunning stages.
Include the exclusion log alongside the worklist.
Record the scan date and version.
Done when the worklist and exclusion log are published.
verify: Retrieve the published worklist for the scan date.
Pass when the published worklist matches the reconciled population.

generic.Defined scope/population: Unpaid policies reaching the statutory advance-notice point before cancellation.
generic.In-scope period: Policies hitting the statutory notice trigger in the current notice cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Amount due, payment deadline, cancellation date, template version and recipient list are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Notice count equals the count of policies reaching the statutory notice point.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Proof of mailing and the state template version are retained against the policy.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Policies missing a required recipient are logged and re-noticed before cancellation.
generic.Test population: All statutory pending-lapse notices issued in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero cancellations proceeding where proof of mailing is missing.
generic.Exception handling path: A missing proof of mailing halts cancellation until the notice is reissued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notice record shows template version, amount due, cancellation date and proof of mailing.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter notice record and the proof of mailing in the document management repository.

steps.title: Confirm the policy has reached the statutory advance-notice point
sop: Compute the statutory notice trigger date from the unpaid due date and state rule.
Select policies reaching that trigger in the cycle.
Confirm the amount shown equals the outstanding balance.
Done when the eligible notice population is selected and amounts verified.
verify: Compare shown amounts to account balances for a sample.
Pass when every sampled notice amount equals the outstanding balance.

steps.title: Generate the notice from the current state-approved template
sop: Select the approved template for the policy state and line.
Confirm the template version is the current filed version.
Generate the notices and record the template version used.
Done when notices are generated from the current approved template.
verify: Compare the recorded template version to the filed version list.
Pass when every notice used the current filed template version.

steps.title: Confirm the notice states amount, deadline and cancellation date
sop: Read a sample notice and check the amount due is shown.
Check the date by which payment must be made is stated.
Check the exact cancellation effective date is stated.
Done when all three elements appear on the sampled notices.
verify: Recompute the cancellation date from the notice date and statutory days.
Pass when the stated cancellation date matches the computed date.

steps.title: Send the notice to all entitled recipients from the policy system
sop: Extract the named insured plus assignees, lienholders and designees.
Confirm each entitled party is on the notice distribution.
Add any missing recipient before release.
Done when every entitled recipient is on the distribution.
verify: Compare the distribution list to the policy interest schedule.
Pass when every entitled party received the notice.

steps.title: Capture proof of mailing in the document management repository
sop: Load the vendor mail date file or certificate of mailing.
File the proof against each policy notice record.
Confirm the proof is retrievable by policy number.
Done when proof of mailing is filed for every released notice.
verify: Retrieve proof of mailing for a sample of notices.
Pass when every sampled notice has a retrievable proof of mailing.

steps.title: Block cancellation where proof of mailing is missing
sop: Compare released notices to filed proofs of mailing.
Flag policies with no proof and block them from the cancellation run.
Reissue the notice for blocked policies.
Done when no policy without proof can enter the cancellation run.
verify: Re-run the proof of mailing comparison before the cancellation run.
Pass when every policy in the cancellation run has proof of mailing.

generic.Defined scope/population: Policies inside an open grace period with a queued lapse transaction pending payment.
generic.In-scope period: Each business day from grace period start to grace period end.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Receipt date, postmark date where required, amount received and halt action are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Halted lapse count equals the count of qualifying payments received in grace.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Daily monitoring log and halt actions are retained with the check date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Short payments are logged with the residual balance and the deadline notified.
generic.Test population: All policies inside an open grace period during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero lapse transactions executed where a qualifying payment arrived before the deadline.
generic.Exception handling path: A late-identified qualifying payment reverses the lapse and reinstates the policy same day.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Monitoring log shows a daily check and a halt action for each qualifying payment.
generic.Evidence location: The monitoring log in the workflow case management tool and BillingCenter receipt records.

steps.title: Run the daily grace-period receipt check in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: List policies inside an open grace period.
Check for receipts posted against each since the last check.
Include suspense items now matched to those policies.
Done when the daily check is complete for every in-grace policy.
verify: Compare checked policy count to the in-grace population.
Pass when every in-grace policy was checked that day.

steps.title: Recognise payment by postmark or receipt date where the state requires it
sop: Read the state rule for payment recognition date.
Use the postmark or receipt date rather than the cash application date.
Record the recognition date used on the receipt.
Done when the recognition date follows the state rule.
verify: Compare the recognition date to the state rule for a sample.
Pass when every sampled recognition date follows the applicable rule.

steps.title: Cancel the queued lapse where the payment clears the amount due
sop: Compare the recognised payment to the amount due.
Cancel the queued lapse transaction where the payment clears it.
Withdraw the pending cancellation notice before release.
Done when qualifying payments have their lapse transactions cancelled.
verify: List lapse transactions still queued on paid policies.
Pass when no fully paid in-grace policy has a queued lapse.

steps.title: Keep the lapse queued and notify on a short payment
sop: Where the payment is short, leave the lapse in queue.
Notify the policyholder of the residual balance and the deadline.
Log the notification against the policy.
Done when every short payment has a logged notification.
verify: Compare short-payment policies to notifications logged.
Pass when every short payment has a notification on record.

steps.title: Reflect the halt in the policy administration system the same day
sop: Send the halt to the policy system for each cancelled lapse.
Confirm the policy status stays in force.
Investigate any policy where the systems disagree.
Done when both systems reflect the halt on the same day.
verify: Compare statuses in both systems for halted policies.
Pass when both systems agree the policy remains in force.

steps.title: Log the daily check and halt actions in the workflow case management tool
sop: Record the check date, the in-grace population and the halts actioned.
Attach the receipt references supporting each halt.
Confirm the log is complete for every business day in grace.
Done when the daily monitoring log is complete.
verify: Read the monitoring log for the review period.
Pass when a daily check entry exists for every business day.

generic.Defined scope/population: Eligible life contracts with an active automatic premium loan election at grace period expiry.
generic.In-scope period: Contracts whose grace period expires in the current premium loan processing cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Loan election flag, available loan value, loan amount, interest rate and effective date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Loan amount raised equals the overdue premium applied to the billing account.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Loan calculation and the owner notification are retained with the loan effective date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Contracts with insufficient loan value are logged and routed to nonforfeiture processing.
generic.Test population: All automatic premium loans raised in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero loans raised in excess of available net loan value.
generic.Exception handling path: Insufficient loan value routes the contract to the nonforfeiture option path instead.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Loan equals the overdue premium and the policy remains in force with no lapse entry.
generic.Evidence location: The contract loan record in the policy system and the BillingCenter premium application.

steps.title: Confirm the automatic premium loan election is active on the contract
sop: Open the contract and read the automatic premium loan election.
Confirm the election is active before grace period expiry.
Exclude contracts without an active election.
Done when the election status is confirmed for each contract.
verify: Re-read the election flag before raising the loan.
Pass when every processed contract carries an active election.

steps.title: Calculate available loan value net of existing loan and interest
sop: Compute net cash value less existing loan and accrued interest.
Compare the result to the overdue premium.
Route contracts with insufficient value to nonforfeiture.
Done when available loan value is computed and compared.
verify: Recompute available loan value for a sample contract.
Pass when the recomputed value supports the loan raised.

steps.title: Raise the loan for the exact overdue premium in the policy system
sop: Raise the loan for the overdue premium amount only.
Set the loan effective date at grace period expiry.
Record the loan transaction reference.
Done when the loan equals the overdue premium.
verify: Compare the loan amount to the overdue premium.
Pass when the two amounts are equal.

steps.title: Apply the loan proceeds to the billing account in BillingCenter
sop: Post the loan proceeds against the overdue installment.
Confirm the account balance clears for that installment.
Confirm no lapse transaction remains queued.
Done when the overdue installment is settled by the loan.
verify: Read the account balance and lapse queue after posting.
Pass when the installment is settled and no lapse remains queued.

steps.title: Confirm loan interest rate, accrual basis and effective date match the provisions
sop: Read the contract loan provisions for rate and accrual basis.
Compare them to the values written on the loan record.
Correct any mismatch before confirmation is issued.
Done when the loan terms match the contract provisions.
verify: Compare the loan record terms to the contract provisions.
Pass when rate, accrual basis and effective date all match.

steps.title: Notify the owner and file the notice in the document repository
sop: Generate the notice stating loan amount, interest rate and effect on values.
Send it to the owner delivery preference of record.
File the notice against the contract.
Done when the owner notice is issued and filed.
verify: Retrieve the notice by contract number.
Pass when the filed notice states the loan amount, rate and value impact.

generic.Defined scope/population: Lapsed policies where the owner or producer has requested reinstatement requirements.
generic.In-scope period: Requests received while the policy remains inside the contractual reinstatement window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Back premium, interest, reinstatement fee, evidence requirement and quote expiry are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Quoted total equals back premium plus contractual interest plus permitted fee.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Written quote and its calculation are logged on the customer case with an expiry date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requests outside the reinstatement window are logged and declined with the reason.
generic.Test population: All reinstatement quotes issued in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero quotes issued for a policy outside its contractual reinstatement window.
generic.Exception handling path: An out-of-window request is redirected to a new business application path.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Quote records back premium, interest, fee, evidence requirement and a validity expiry date.
generic.Evidence location: The CRM customer case, the BillingCenter balance detail and the policy system lapse record.

steps.title: Confirm the policy is inside the contractual reinstatement window
sop: Read the lapse date and the contractual reinstatement window length.
Compute whether the request falls inside the window.
Decline and redirect requests outside the window.
Done when the window position is confirmed and recorded.
verify: Recompute elapsed time since lapse against the window.
Pass when every quoted policy is inside its reinstatement window.

steps.title: Calculate back premium from the paid-to date in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Read the premium-paid-to date at lapse.
Sum premium due from that date to the reinstatement date.
Show each installment separately on the calculation.
Done when back premium is calculated and itemised.
verify: Recompute the back premium from the installment schedule.
Pass when the recomputed total equals the quoted back premium.

steps.title: Add contractual interest where the policy provides for it
sop: Read the contract interest provision for reinstatement.
Compute interest on the back premium at the stated rate.
Omit interest where the contract does not provide for it.
Done when interest is computed or documented as not applicable.
verify: Compare the interest computed to the contract provision.
Pass when the interest charged follows the contract provision.

steps.title: Add the reinstatement fee permitted by the filed rate
sop: Look up the reinstatement fee filed for the policy state.
Add the fee where permitted and omit it where prohibited.
Record the filing reference for the fee applied.
Done when the fee is added or documented as not applicable.
verify: Compare the fee to the filed rate for the policy state.
Pass when the fee matches the filed rate or is correctly omitted.

steps.title: State the evidence of insurability requirement on the quote
sop: Determine whether evidence of insurability is required for the elapsed period.
State the form the applicant must complete.
Record the underwriting routing for the completed evidence.
Done when the evidence requirement and form are stated.
verify: Compare the stated requirement to the contract and underwriting rules.
Pass when the stated requirement matches the applicable rule.

steps.title: Issue the written quote with an expiry date and log it in the CRM
sop: Issue the quote in writing showing every component and the total.
State the quote expiry date.
Log the quote and its components on the customer case.
Done when the quote is issued and logged with an expiry date.
verify: Retrieve the quote from the customer case.
Pass when the logged quote shows all components and an expiry date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Lapsed policies where a qualifying reinstatement payment has been received.
generic.In-scope period: Payments received before the reinstatement quote expiry date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Payment amount, quote reference, evidence approval, effective date and corrected paid-to date are set.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Received funds equal the quoted back premium plus interest plus fee.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Quote, payment record and underwriting approval are retained with the reinstatement date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Short payments are logged and the reinstatement held until the shortfall is cleared.
generic.Test population: All policies reinstated in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero policies reinstated on a payment short of the quoted qualifying amount.
generic.Exception handling path: A short payment is held as unapplied cash pending the balance or a refund instruction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reinstated policy shows the qualifying payment, evidence approval and a corrected paid-to date.
generic.Evidence location: The policy system reinstatement transaction and the BillingCenter payment and schedule records.

steps.title: Confirm the received funds equal the quoted qualifying amount
sop: Compare the received amount to the quoted back premium, interest and fee.
Confirm the funds arrived before the quote expiry date.
Hold short payments as unapplied cash.
Done when the payment is confirmed as qualifying or held.
verify: Recompute the quoted total and compare to funds received.
Pass when received funds equal or exceed the quoted qualifying amount.

steps.title: Confirm evidence of insurability was submitted and approved
sop: Check whether evidence was required by the quote.
Confirm underwriting approval is recorded where required.
Hold the reinstatement where approval is outstanding.
Done when evidence approval is confirmed or documented as not required.
verify: Read the underwriting decision on the reinstatement case.
Pass when approval predates the reinstatement where evidence was required.

steps.title: Set the reinstatement effective date per the contract provision
sop: Read the contract provision governing the reinstatement effective date.
Set the effective date accordingly.
Confirm no unintended coverage gap or unintended coverage grant results.
Done when the effective date follows the contract provision.
verify: Compare the effective date to the contract provision.
Pass when the effective date follows the stated provision.

steps.title: Restore the billing schedule and reactivate the mandate in BillingCenter
sop: Rebuild the installment schedule with the corrected paid-to date.
Set the next due date consistent with the reinstatement.
Reactivate the EFT mandate where one existed.
Done when the schedule and mandate are restored.
verify: Read the schedule and mandate status after restoration.
Pass when the schedule reflects the corrected paid-to date and the mandate is active.

steps.title: Return the policy status to in force in the policy administration system
sop: Post the reinstatement transaction.
Confirm the policy status returns to in force.
Record the transaction reference on the case.
Done when the policy status shows in force.
verify: Re-read the policy status after the transaction.
Pass when the status is in force with the reinstatement reference.

steps.title: Confirm downstream systems receive the reinstatement update
sop: Confirm claims eligibility and commission systems received the status change.
Work any interface reject arising from the update.
Record the confirmations on the case.
Done when downstream systems reflect the reinstatement.
verify: Check the interface logs for the reinstatement message.
Pass when every downstream system acknowledged the update.

generic.Defined scope/population: Policies entering grace, cured within grace, lapsed and reinstated during the reporting period.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period from prior period end to current period end.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Entered, cured, lapsed and reinstated counts plus annualised premium are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reported lapsed premium reconciles to policy system lapse transactions for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report version and warehouse extract are retained with the period end date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Adverse movements by product, state or billing mode are called out with commentary.
generic.Test population: All policies with a grace, lapse or reinstatement event in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero unreconciled variance between reported lapsed premium and policy system transactions.
generic.Exception handling path: A reconciliation variance holds distribution until the Accountant explains it.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Report shows entered, cured and lapsed counts with a reconciled conversion rate.
generic.Evidence location: The BI reporting platform lapse report and the warehouse lapse event extract.

steps.title: Extract grace, lapse and reinstatement events to the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Extract policies entering grace, cured, lapsed and reinstated in the period.
Include annualised premium, product line, state and billing mode.
Load the extract into the reporting tables.
Done when the event extract is loaded for the period.
verify: Compare loaded event counts to source system counts.
Pass when loaded counts equal the source event counts.

steps.title: Compute the grace-period conversion rate in the BI reporting platform
sop: Compute cured divided by entered for the period.
Split the rate by product line and billing mode.
Confirm the splits reconcile to the overall rate.
Done when the conversion rate and its splits are computed.
verify: Recompute the overall rate from the split populations.
Pass when the splits reconcile to the overall conversion rate.

steps.title: Add reinstatement volumes and rate for the trailing period
sop: Count reinstatements and compute the reinstatement rate over lapses.
Show the trailing period trend alongside the current period.
Confirm counts tie to the event extract.
Done when reinstatement volume and rate are on the report.
verify: Recount reinstatements from the extract.
Pass when the reported count equals the extract count.

steps.title: Reconcile lapsed premium to policy system lapse transactions
sop: Extract lapse transactions and their premium from the policy system.
Compare to reported lapsed premium for the same period.
Document any reconciling item before distribution.
Done when the report ties to policy system transactions.
verify: Recompute the reconciliation from both sources.
Pass when the difference is zero or fully documented.

steps.title: Highlight adverse movement by product, state or billing mode
sop: Compare current period rates to the prior period by dimension.
Highlight dimensions with adverse movement beyond tolerance.
Write commentary for each highlighted dimension.
Done when every adverse movement carries commentary.
verify: Filter highlighted dimensions for missing commentary.
Pass when no highlighted dimension lacks commentary.

steps.title: Deliver the report to product and finance management
sop: Publish the report to product and finance distribution lists.
Record the publication date and report version.
Retain the published version with the period end date.
Done when the report is delivered and retained.
verify: Read the publication log for the report.
Pass when the log shows delivery to product and finance for the period.

generic.Defined scope/population: Policies with an unpaid premium requiring a grace period counter to start.
generic.In-scope period: Premium due dates passing unpaid in the current grace period start cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Grace start date, grace end date, state rule reference and product rule are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Grace counters started equal the count of unpaid premiums identified for the cycle.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Grace dates written to both systems are retained with the rule version applied.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Counters started from the wrong date are logged and corrected before lapse processing.
generic.Test population: All grace period counters started in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero counters started from the past-due identification date instead of the due date.
generic.Exception handling path: An incorrect start date is corrected and downstream lapse dates are recalculated.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Grace start and end dates are stored on both records and derive from the premium due date.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter grace period fields and the corresponding policy system grace record.

steps.title: Read the unpaid premium due date in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Identify the unpaid installment and its due date.
Confirm the due date is not shifted by the identification run date.
Record the due date as the grace start basis.
Done when the grace start basis is the premium due date.
verify: Compare the recorded start basis to the installment due date.
Pass when the start basis equals the premium due date.

steps.title: Apply the grace period length from the state and product rule table
sop: Look up the grace period length for the policy state and product.
Apply the statutory minimum where the contract is shorter.
Record the rule reference used.
Done when the grace length and its rule reference are recorded.
verify: Compare the applied length to the rule table entry.
Pass when the applied length matches the state and product rule.

steps.title: Write the grace end date to the billing account in BillingCenter
sop: Compute the grace end date from the start date and length.
Write it to the billing account grace fields.
Confirm downstream lapse scheduling uses that date.
Done when the billing account carries the grace end date.
verify: Recompute the end date from the start and length.
Pass when the stored end date equals the recomputed date.

steps.title: Write the same grace dates to the policy record
sop: Write the grace start and end dates to the policy record.
Confirm both systems hold identical dates.
Correct any divergence immediately.
Done when both systems hold the same grace dates.
verify: Compare the grace dates in both systems.
Pass when the dates are identical in billing and policy records.

steps.title: Confirm coverage remains in force during the grace period
sop: Confirm the policy status remains in force for the grace duration.
Confirm no claim block is applied prematurely.
Raise any premature block for immediate removal.
Done when coverage is confirmed in force through the grace period.
verify: Read the policy status and claim eligibility during grace.
Pass when coverage is in force and no premature claim block exists.

steps.title: Verify the counter is not restarted by unrelated billing transactions
sop: Monitor accounts in grace for transactions that reset the counter.
Confirm the grace start date remains unchanged after such transactions.
Restore the original date where a reset occurred.
Done when grace start dates are stable across the grace period.
verify: Compare current grace start dates to the originally recorded dates.
Pass when no grace counter was restarted by an unrelated transaction.

generic.Defined scope/population: Billing accounts for policies lapsed or cancelled where future billing must stop.
generic.In-scope period: Accounts with a cancellation effective date in the current suppression cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Suppression flag, effective date, mandate status and open installment status are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Suppressed account count equals the count of policies cancelled in the cycle.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Suppression entry and mandate deactivation are recorded with the cancellation effective date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Queued notices withdrawn late are logged with the withdrawal evidence.
generic.Test population: All accounts suppressed following cancellation in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero notices or drafts generated after the cancellation effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: A notice issued in error is withdrawn and an apology correction is issued to the policyholder.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Billing account is suppressed with an effective date matching the cancellation.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter account suppression record and the Payment Gateway mandate status.

steps.title: Set the billing account to suppressed in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Set the account status to suppressed or closed.
Set the suppression effective date to the cancellation effective date.
Record the cancellation reference on the account.
Done when the account is suppressed from the cancellation date.
verify: Compare the suppression date to the cancellation effective date.
