Pass when both dates are identical.

steps.title: Deactivate the EFT or card mandate in the Payment Gateway
sop: Deactivate the mandate so no further draft can generate.
Confirm the gateway reflects the deactivation.
Record the deactivation reference on the account.
Done when the mandate is deactivated in both systems.
verify: Query the mandate status in BillingCenter and the gateway.
Pass when both show the mandate inactive.

steps.title: Withdraw queued but unreleased premium notices in BillingCenter
sop: List queued notices for the account not yet released to print.
Withdraw each before the print run.
Record the withdrawal on the account.
Done when no queued notice remains for the account.
verify: Re-query the notice queue for the account.
Pass when no notice remains queued after suppression.

steps.title: Close installments due after the cancellation effective date
sop: List open installments with due dates after the cancellation date.
Close or void each one.
Confirm the account balance reflects only earned amounts.
Done when no post-cancellation installment remains open.
verify: Re-list open installments on the account.
Pass when no installment carries a due date after cancellation.

steps.title: Verify the next billing run produces no notice or draft for the account
sop: Run the next notice and draft selections in preview mode.
Confirm the account is not selected by either process.
Investigate any selection and correct the suppression.
Done when the account is excluded from both selections.
verify: Read the preview selection output for the account.
Pass when the account appears in neither the notice nor draft selection.

steps.title: Reconcile suppressed accounts to cancelled policies for the cycle
sop: Count policies cancelled in the cycle.
Count billing accounts suppressed for the same cycle.
Suppress any account missed by the run.
Done when suppressed accounts equal cancelled policies.
verify: Recount both populations after remediation.
Pass when every cancelled policy has a suppressed billing account.

generic.Defined scope/population: Approved return premium calculations awaiting transmission to refund processing.
generic.In-scope period: Cancellations with an approved return premium in the current transmission cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, cancellation date, method, net amount, payee entitlement and acknowledgement are set.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Transmitted amount equals the approved return premium calculation to the cent.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Transmission record and refund processing acknowledgement are retained with the cancellation.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Transmissions rejected by refund processing are logged and corrected before resend.
generic.Test population: All return premium transmissions issued in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero duplicate return premium transmissions for the same cancellation transaction.
generic.Exception handling path: A rejected transmission is corrected and resent with the original cancellation reference.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Transmission carries policy number, calculated amount and a receiving-process acknowledgement.
generic.Evidence location: The workflow case management record, the BillingCenter credit flag and the ERP refund queue.

steps.title: Assemble the transmission payload in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Collect policy number, cancellation effective date, method and net refund amount.
Attach the approved calculation worksheet reference.
Validate no field is blank before transmission.
Done when the payload is complete for every approved calculation.
verify: Filter payloads for blank required fields.
Pass when no payload has a blank required field.

steps.title: Confirm the transmitted amount equals the approved calculation
sop: Compare the payload amount to the approved calculation net return.
Correct any difference before transmission.
Record the comparison on the case.
Done when the payload amount equals the approved calculation.
verify: Recompute the difference between payload and calculation.
Pass when the difference is zero cents.

steps.title: Include the payee entitlement determination with the transmission
sop: Read the entitlement determination naming insured, finance company or lienholder.
Attach the determination and its supporting document reference.
Reject transmissions with no entitlement determination.
Done when each transmission carries an entitlement determination.
verify: Check the entitlement field on each transmitted item.
Pass when every transmission names an entitled payee with support.

steps.title: Transmit through the workflow case management tool to refund processing
sop: Send the payload to the refund processing queue.
Record the transmission date and reference on the cancellation.
Work any immediate validation reject.
Done when the payload is accepted into the refund queue.
verify: Read the queue entry for the transmitted item.
Pass when the item appears once in the refund processing queue.

steps.title: Record the refund processing acknowledgement against the cancellation
sop: Capture the acknowledgement reference returned by refund processing.
Write it onto the cancellation record.
Chase any transmission with no acknowledgement.
Done when every transmission carries an acknowledgement reference.
verify: Filter transmissions for missing acknowledgements.
Pass when no transmission lacks an acknowledgement reference.

steps.title: Flag the billing account credit as pending refund in BillingCenter
sop: Flag the credit balance as pending refund on the account.
Confirm no other process can select the same credit for refund.
Record the flag against the transmission reference.
Done when the credit is flagged as pending refund.
verify: Search for duplicate transmissions on the same cancellation.
Pass when only one transmission exists per cancellation transaction.

generic.Defined scope/population: Lapsed policies requiring a lapse notification message to policy administration.
generic.In-scope period: Lapses executed in the current business day interface cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, lapse effective date, non-payment reason code and last paid-to date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Notification count equals the count of lapse transactions executed for the day.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Message payload and the policy system acknowledgement are retained with the run date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rejected notifications in the error queue are logged and reprocessed the same business day.
generic.Test population: All lapse notifications transmitted in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero lapse notifications left unacknowledged in the interface error queue at day close.
generic.Exception handling path: A rejected message is corrected and resent the same day rather than deferred.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notification and matching policy status update exist with the same effective date.
generic.Evidence location: The BillingCenter interface log and the policy administration system status history.

steps.title: Build the lapse notification payload in Guidewire BillingCenter
sop: Populate policy number, lapse effective date, reason code and last paid-to date.
Use the statutory cancellation date from the notice as the effective date.
Validate the payload before transmission.
Done when a complete payload exists for every lapsed policy.
verify: Compare the effective date to the statutory notice date.
Pass when the payload effective date equals the notice cancellation date.

steps.title: Transmit the notification to the policy administration system
sop: Send the notification through the interface.
Capture the message identifier for each transmission.
Record the transmission on the billing case.
Done when every lapsed policy has a transmitted notification.
verify: Compare transmitted message count to lapse transaction count.
Pass when the counts agree for the run.

steps.title: Confirm the policy system acknowledges and updates the status
sop: Read the acknowledgement for each transmitted message.
Confirm the policy status updated to lapsed with the reason code.
Escalate any acknowledged message with no status change.
Done when every acknowledgement pairs with a status update.
verify: Compare acknowledged messages to policy status changes.
Pass when every acknowledgement has a matching status update.

steps.title: Work the interface error queue the same business day
sop: Open the interface error queue for lapse notifications.
Correct the payload defect for each rejected message.
Resend the corrected message the same day.
Done when the error queue is cleared for the run.
verify: Re-query the error queue at day close.
Pass when no lapse notification remains unacknowledged.

steps.title: Confirm dependent downstream updates are triggered
sop: Confirm commission chargeback and claims eligibility updates fired.
List any downstream system that did not receive the change.
Reprocess the missing downstream updates.
Done when all dependent updates are confirmed.
verify: Check downstream logs for the lapse status change.
Pass when every dependent system reflects the lapse.

steps.title: Reconcile notifications to lapse transactions in the workflow tool
sop: Count lapse transactions executed for the day.
Count acknowledged notifications for the same day.
Investigate and resolve any difference before close.
Done when the counts agree for the business day.
verify: Recount both populations at day close.
Pass when acknowledged notifications equal executed lapse transactions.
